title: Capristo Valved Exhaust System for Lamborghini Temerario
body: The Capristo Valved Exhaust System for the Lamborghini Temerario has been developed to give Lamborghini's new twin-turbo V8 supercar a more distinctive and engaging exhaust character while retaining full valve functionality. Designed specifically for the Lamborghini Temerario (LB634) , the system is manufactured by Capristo in Sundern, Germany from high-temperature T309 (1.4828) stainless steel . Each system is TIG welded by hand, polished after welding and equipped with Capristo's proprietary exhaust valves. The exhaust can be ordered on its own or combined with Capristo downpipes to create a complete Temerario exhaust system. Available configurations include 250-cell sport catalytic converters, 100-cell sport catalytic converters and TwinFlow catless downpipes . Key Features Vehicle: Lamborghini Temerario (LB634) Engine: 4.0L twin-turbo V8 hybrid Exhaust type: Valved performance exhaust system Material: T309 / 1.4828 stainless steel Construction: Hand TIG welded and polished Heat protection: Integrated heat-resistant metal shielding Manufactured in: Sundern, Germany Capristo exhaust part number: 02LA14303007 Choose Your Configuration Valved Exhaust The Capristo rear exhaust system replaces the factory exhaust section while retaining electronically controlled exhaust valves. This configuration is ideal for owners looking for more sound and character without replacing the original downpipes. Full System – 250 Cell Sport Cats Combines the Capristo valved exhaust with the 250-cell sport catalytic downpipes. Capristo uses its patented GPF/OPF technology on this version, designed to allow increased exhaust flow while preventing a Check Engine Light related to removal of the factory particulate filter system. Full System – 100 Cell Sport Cats For customers looking for a more aggressive exhaust configuration, the 100-cell sport catalytic converters provide a less restrictive exhaust path. Capristo states that the OBD Wizard Pro may be required for CEL elimination with this configuration. Full System – Catless Downpipes The most performance-focused configuration combines the valved exhaust with Capristo's TwinFlow Cat Spare Downpipes with heat protection. This setup is intended for off-road and track use where permitted. Capristo Sport Cat & Downpipe Options Both Capristo sport-cat configurations use the same high-temperature T309 stainless-steel construction as the exhaust system. The downpipes are hand welded, polished and fitted with heat-resistant metal jackets to help manage temperatures around the Temerario's twin-turbo V8 powertrain. The 250-cell version uses Capristo's patented GPF/OPF solution and is designed to prevent a catalyst or particulate-filter related Check Engine Light. The more aggressive 100-cell configuration may require the optional Capristo OBD Wizard Pro. Optional Exhaust Valve Control The optional Capristo E2E Exhaust Valve Remote Kit gives the driver additional manual control over the electronically operated exhaust valves

title: Capristo E2E Exhaust Valve Remote Kit
body: The Capristo E2E Exhaust Valve Remote Kit adds manual opening control to compatible electronic exhaust valves, including those on the Lamborghini Temerario. Kit C connects between the factory wiring and valve actuators. Its electronic piggyback controller lets the driver override the normal ECU valve strategy using the remote. Key Features Version: E2E Remote Kit C Installation: Plug-and-play harness connection without cutting factory wiring Function: Manually open compatible electronic exhaust valves Capristo part number: 04AZ00703009C Fitment Capristo lists the Lamborghini Temerario and Revuelto, plus selected Ferrari and Porsche models. Please confirm your vehicle and valve configuration before ordering. Optional Exhaust Valve Control Available separately from the Capristo Temerario exhaust system .

It has been developed specifically for the latest Turbo S and retains valve control through the factory Porsche Sport Exhaust (PSE) controls. The production system is manufactured from titanium and uses extensive heat shielding around critical sections of the exhaust. Catted or Catless The catted full system uses 200 CPSI high-flow catalytic converters , combining increased exhaust flow with retained catalytic converters. The catless full system provides the least restrictive exhaust route and is intended for applications where local legislation permits its use. title: BC Forged AF55 Forged Wheels
body: The BC Forged AF55 is a premium one-piece forged monoblock wheel built around a clean, sculpted five-spoke design. Broad flowing spokes, large brake openings and a deep concave profile give the AF55 a strong motorsport character without making the wheel visually too busy. It is an especially strong choice for Porsche 911, 718, Taycan, Panamera and Cayenne applications. The simple five-spoke architecture works naturally with Porsche's design language, while the open spoke layout leaves larger brake systems and Porsche Ceramic Composite Brake calipers clearly visible. For the Porsche 911 in particular, the AF55 sits perfectly between OEM-plus and modern motorsport . It looks purposeful enough for a GT3 or GT3 RS, yet remains clean and refined enough for a Carrera, GTS, Turbo or Turbo S. Each AF55 wheel is machined from 6061-T6 forged aluminum and manufactured specifically for the vehicle. Width, offset, bolt pattern, center bore, brake clearance and final wheel position are determined for the individual application rather than forcing the car into a generic off-the-shelf fitment. Why The BC Forged AF55 Works So Well On Porsche Few wheel designs suit such a wide range of Porsche models as naturally as the AF55. Its five-spoke layout is simple enough to complement the clean body lines of a 911, while the broad sculpted spokes give the wheel enough presence for wider and more aggressive models such as the Turbo S, GT3 and GT3 RS. The design also exposes a large part of the brake system. This works particularly well on Porsche models fitted with larger steel brakes or PCCB ceramic brakes , where the calipers become an important part of the overall wheel design. Another advantage is proportion. Because the AF55 does not rely on a large number of thin spokes, the wheel remains visually strong even in larger diameters. This makes it equally suitable for a lightweight 718 Cayman, a 992-generation 911, a Taycan or a larger Cayenne. Porsche 911, 992 & 992.2 Fitment The BC Forged AF55 is particularly well suited to the Porsche 911 , including 991, 992 and 992.2-generation cars. The combination of its clean five-spoke design, large brake openings and vehicle-specific concavity makes it especially attractive on Carrera, GTS, Turbo, GT3 and GT3 RS models. Five-Spoke Design With Deep Concavity The defining feature of the AF55 is its sculpted five-spoke layout . Each spoke flows outward from the center section before widening towards the outer edge of the wheel. The result is a design that looks muscular without appearing heavy. Large openings between the spokes create visual depth and allow the brake hardware to remain clearly visible. Combined with the available concavity profiles, this gives the AF55 a strong three-dimensional appearance when viewed from the rear quarter of the car. body: H&R lowering springs for the Porsche 992.2 Turbo S reduce the wheel arch gap for a more purposeful stance. Two applications are available, matched to the car’s factory PASM suspension: approximately 20 mm lowering for PASM sport suspension or 30 mm for PASM standard suspension. The correct spring set depends on your vehicle’s original suspension specification. Select the version using the Porsche equipment code, rather than the amount of lowering you prefer. Choose the Correct H&R Spring Set H&R Part Number Factory Suspension Equipment Code Approximate Lowering 28628-1 PASM sport suspension 1BV 20 mm 28628-2 PASM standard suspension 1BH 30 mm PASM Suspension and Front Axle Lift Both applications are available for vehicles with PASM suspension and if the Porsche is equipped with the factory lift system, it is fully compatible. A More Coordinated Wheel and Suspension Setup Lowering changes the relationship between the body, wheels and tyres. If your Porsche already has aftermarket wheels, or you are planning a new set, the wheel dimensions, tyre sizes and available clearance should be assessed alongside the suspension change. BaanVelgen can help you plan the H&R springs together with a BC Forged wheel configuration or assess the combination with the BBS FI-R EVO wheel application for the Porsche 992.2 Turbo S . The complete configuration should be checked before ordering. Frequently Asked Questions Which H&R spring set do I need? Choose 28628-1 for PASM sport suspension with equipment code 1BV, or 28628-2 for PASM standard suspension with equipment code 1BH. Confirm the code before ordering. Can I choose the 30 mm springs for a car with sport suspension? The spring set must match the factory suspension application. title: Akrapovič Slip-On Line BMW M2 CS G87
body: The Akrapovič Slip-On Line (Titanium) for the BMW M2 CS G87 is a lightweight, valve-controlled titanium exhaust system developed specifically for the high-performance M2 CS. With ECE type approval for the OPF/GPF-equipped BMW M2 CS, it combines a deeper and more engaging S58 exhaust note with significant weight reduction and measurable performance gains. Manufactured from high-grade titanium, the system features two exhaust valves, dedicated acoustic reflectors and titanium components cast in Akrapovič's own foundry. The result is an exhaust that remains refined during normal driving but develops a much deeper and sportier character when the M2 CS is driven more dynamically. Akrapovič exhaust for the BMW M2 CS G87 The BMW M2 CS takes the G87 platform considerably further, and Akrapovič developed the S-BM/T/39H Slip-On Line specifically for this application. The system replaces the factory rear exhaust section while retaining the usability expected from a road-going M2 CS. Its titanium construction reduces exhaust weight by 7.3 kg, equivalent to a 32.7% weight saving compared with the standard rear exhaust . Two electronically controlled exhaust valves and two acoustic reflectors manage gas flow and sound depending on driving conditions. At normal cruising speeds, the system produces a smooth and rich tone. Under greater engine load and at higher revs, the valves and acoustic design allow the S58 straight-six to develop a deeper, more purposeful exhaust note. Performance and weight reduction Akrapovič tested the Slip-On Line on a BMW M2 CS with the standard factory exhaust as the reference. The titanium system delivered measurable improvements in both power and torque without requiring ECU remapping. This makes the Slip-On Line particularly attractive for European M2 CS owners who want a more distinctive exhaust sound and substantial weight reduction while retaining an ECE-approved exhaust configuration. No ECU remapping is required when the Slip-On Line is installed in its standard configuration. How does the Akrapovič M2 CS exhaust sound? The objective of the Akrapovič system is not simply to make the M2 CS louder. Its dual exhaust valves and acoustic reflectors are designed to give the S58 engine a broader range of sound depending on how the car is being driven. title: Akrapovič Slip-On Titanium Exhaust Mercedes-AMG CLE 53 C236 / A236
body: The Akrapovič Slip-On Line (Titanium) for the Mercedes-AMG CLE 53 4MATIC Coupé and Cabriolet (C236 / A236) brings a more distinctive and engaging exhaust character to the CLE 53 while retaining the refinement expected from a modern Mercedes-AMG. The system is constructed entirely from high-grade titanium. It combines premium materials with sophisticated valve-controlled acoustics and seamless integration with the Mercedes-AMG CLE 53. The system is ECE type approved for vehicles equipped with a gasoline particulate filter (GPF) and requires no ECU remapping. Akrapovič exhaust for Mercedes-AMG CLE 53 Developed specifically for the Mercedes-AMG CLE 53, the Slip-On Line features two pairs of bumper-mounted tailpipes with hand-crafted carbon-fibre outer sleeves and titanium inner sleeves . The exhaust has been engineered to provide a smooth and refined sound during everyday driving, becoming progressively sportier and more dramatic as engine load and rpm increase. Special collectors inside both mufflers help eliminate unwanted streaming noise, while internal acoustic cones act as reflectors to partially direct exhaust sound from the tailpipes towards the cabin. The result is a more engaging acoustic experience without sacrificing cruising comfort. Valve-controlled Akrapovič sound Sound is managed through two exhaust valves that respond to driving parameters and precisely control the opening and closing of the valves. This allows the character of the exhaust to change naturally according to engine speed and load. At lower loads and cruising speeds, the system remains smooth and refined. Under more dynamic driving conditions, the Mercedes-AMG CLE 53 gains a stronger, sportier and more pronounced exhaust note. Key features Full high-grade titanium construction Developed specifically for the Mercedes-AMG CLE 53 Valve-controlled exhaust sound Two exhaust valves Hand-crafted carbon-fibre tailpipe outer sleeves Titanium tailpipe inner sleeves ECE type approved Compatible with vehicles equipped with a gasoline particulate filter (GPF) Plug-and-play installation No ECU remapping required Optional Akrapovič Sound Kit available Vehicle compatibility Mercedes-AMG CLE 53 4MATIC Coupé – C236 Mercedes-AMG CLE 53 4MATIC Cabriolet – A236 For vehicles equipped with a gasoline particulate filter (GPF) The ECE type-approval certificate covers both the C236 Coupé and A236 Cabriolet . ECE type approved The Akrapovič Slip-On Line (Titanium) S-ME/T/16H is ECE type approved for the Mercedes-AMG CLE 53 equipped with a gasoline particulate filter. Installation is plug-and-play and no ECU remapping is required, making this an attractive exhaust upgrade for owners who want more sound and character while retaining an ECE-approved configuration. Optional Akrapovič Sound Kit For drivers looking for additional control over the acoustic experience, the exhaust can be combined with the optional Akrapovič Sound Kit . title: BAAN Air Suspension Lowering Links for Zeekr 7X
body: BAAN Air Suspension Lowering Links for the Zeekr 7X are developed specifically for all Zeekr 7X models equipped with factory air suspension . The adjustable links allow you to lower the vehicle mechanically while retaining the functionality of the original Zeekr air-suspension system. body: APEX ML-10RT forged wheels are a forged mesh design combining classic motorsport styling with modern monoblock construction. This complete APEX ML-10RT product contains 315 official wheel SKUs in 17–20 inch, with vehicle-specific widths, offsets, bolt patterns, center bores, face profiles and finishes. Each wheel is sold individually. Select the wheel diameter, exact APEX specification and finish from the options above. The range covers applications for 86/BRZ, BMW, Chevrolet, Ford, Honda, Nissan, Porsche, Tesla, VW/Audi. APEX ML-10RT highlights Forged 6061-T6 aluminium monoblock construction Motorsport-inspired design with road-focused durability Vehicle-specific spoke profiles and concavity Engineered for brake clearance and precise fitment Available specifications Diameter: 17–20 inch Construction: Forged Product family: Touring Line Available finishes: Anthracite - Machined Lip, Brushed Clear - Machined Lip, Gloss Motorsport Gold - Machined Lip, Race Silver - Machined Lip Official variants: 315 Fitment and ordering Correct wheel fitment depends on the exact vehicle generation, brake package, suspension, tyre size and intended use. title: BAAN Air Suspension Lowering Links for Audi A6 C8
body: BAAN Air Suspension Lowering Links for Audi A6 C8 are developed by BaanVelgen for the Audi A6 C8 equipped with factory adaptive air suspension. Give the Audi A6 C8 a lower, cleaner profile while retaining the versatility of its original suspension system. BAAN Lowering Links combine model-specific fitment with straightforward mechanical adjustment. Key benefits for the A6 C8 Complete vehicle-specific solution: The price includes a complete vehicle-specific lowering-link set for the front and rear axles. Adjustable while installed: opposing left-hand and right-hand threads allow fine adjustment by rotating the central adjuster while the links remain connected to the vehicle. Corrosion-resistant construction: precision-machined aluminium adjusters are combined with stainless-steel link ends and ball-joint sockets for exposed underbody use. Secure mechanical retention: locking nuts secure the selected length and dual metal safety-retaining clips help keep the sockets connected to the factory sensor balls. No coding or electronic module: the links mechanically change the ride-height sensor reference without adding a controller to the vehicle wiring. Reversible installation: the original sensor links can be reinstalled to return the vehicle to its original configuration. A6 C8 lowering range Front axle 0 to approximately 50 mm lower Rear axle 0 to approximately 50 mm lower Front and rear settings can be fine-tuned independently where applicable. The final measured ride height depends on the original vehicle calibration, suspension mode, vehicle load, tyre pressure and wheel-and-tyre configuration. Substantial lowering should be assessed for tyre clearance, suspension travel and road suitability. body: BBS LM Le Mans wheels for the Porsche 911 Carrera 2 and Carrera 4 (964) combine one of the most iconic multi-piece wheel designs in automotive history with a carefully selected 18-inch fitment for the narrow-body, also known as small-body, Porsche 964. Introduced in 1994 and inspired by the BBS racing wheels used at the 24 Hours of Le Mans, the BBS LM is particularly well suited to the proportions and character of the air-cooled Porsche 911. title: Novitec NF8 Directional Forged Wheels - Ferrari 296 GTB & GTS
body: The Novitec NF8 Directional Forged wheels for the Ferrari 296 GTB and Ferrari 296 GTS . Their distinctive directional design, lightweight forged construction and vehicle-specific dimensions give the Ferrari 296 a sharper stance while preserving the precision expected from a modern Ferrari supercar. Manufactured by Vossen exclusively for Novitec , the NF8 is not a conventional wheel design repeated four times. Each wheel is individually engineered for its exact position on the vehicle: front left, front right, rear left and rear right. This ensures that the directional spokes rotate in the intended visual and aerodynamic direction on every corner of the car. Available in 20"/21", 21"/21" and 21"/22" staggered configurations , the NF8 can be specified for an OEM-inspired appearance, a balanced performance setup or maximum visual impact. Four Corner-Specific Directional Wheels The defining feature of the Novitec NF8 is its true directional construction. Many directional-style wheels use the same wheel design on both sides of the vehicle, causing the spokes to face forwards on one side and backwards on the other. Novitec and Vossen developed the NF8 differently. A separate wheel is manufactured for every position on the Ferrari 296, allowing the five pairs of spokes to follow the same direction of rotation on both sides of the car. This creates a balanced and technically correct appearance from every angle. The angled spoke geometry is also designed to guide airflow through the wheel area and support ventilation around the braking system. Key Features Designed for the Ferrari 296 GTB and Ferrari 296 GTS True directional design with a different wheel for each corner Manufactured by Vossen exclusively for Novitec Forged monoblock aluminium construction Five twin-spoke directional wheel design Vehicle-specific widths, offsets and load specifications Engineered for compatibility with the Ferrari braking system Available in multiple staggered diameter combinations Wide selection of solid, brushed, polished and transparent finishes Made to order for the individual vehicle Available Ferrari 296 Fitments The Novitec NF8 is available in three different configurations. Each setup offers a different balance between ride quality, steering response and visual presence. 20"/21" Performance Configuration Front wheels: 9.5J x 20" Rear wheels: 11.5J x 21" Recommended front tyres: 255/35 R20 Recommended rear tyres: 325/25 R21 The 20"/21" combination maintains additional tyre sidewall at the front axle. It is the most understated NF8 configuration and an excellent choice for owners who prioritise steering feel, road usability and an appearance closer to the original Ferrari proportions. 21"/21" Balanced OEM+ Configuration Front wheels: 9.5J x 21" Rear wheels: 11.5J x 21" Recommended front tyres: 255/30 R21 Recommended rear tyres: 325/25 R21 The equal-diameter 21"/21" setup creates a more contemporary and visually balanced profile. title: KW Height Adjustable Springs for Porsche 911 992.2 Carrera
body: The KW Height Adjustable Springs for the Porsche 911 992.2 Carrera are the ideal suspension upgrade for owners who want a lower, more purposeful stance while retaining the original factory dampers. Designed as a premium alternative to conventional lowering springs, the KW HAS kit gives your Porsche 992.2 adjustable ride height, improved steering response and a more refined wheel-to-arch fitment without converting to a full coilover suspension. For many Porsche 992.2 owners, the factory suspension already offers an excellent balance between comfort, control and everyday usability. The KW Height Adjustable Springs build on that foundation by lowering the car in a controlled, vehicle-specific way while keeping the OEM damper system active. This makes the kit especially suitable for cars equipped with PASM, where the factory adaptive damping functions remain retained. Adjustable lowering for the perfect Porsche 992.2 stance Unlike fixed lowering springs, the KW HAS system allows the ride height to be adjusted within the approved range even after installation. This makes it possible to fine-tune the stance of your Porsche 911 992.2 Carrera based on your wheel setup, tyre size, driving preference and visual target. This is especially valuable when combining the car with forged wheels, aftermarket wheel fitments or a more aggressive OEM+ setup. Whether the goal is a subtle factory-style drop or a cleaner, more performance-oriented appearance, the KW Height Adjustable Springs give you more flexibility than a traditional spring kit. Retains the original Porsche driving character The KW Height Adjustable Springs are developed to work with the original Porsche dampers. The result is a suspension upgrade that improves the visual stance and sharpens the response of the car, while keeping the refined character of the Porsche 911 intact. Because the original damper system remains in place, the car keeps the comfort and functionality expected from a modern 911. The kit is therefore a strong choice for road-driven Porsche 992.2 Carrera models where daily usability, ride quality and premium driving feel are just as important as the final stance. body: Novitec NF9 Forged Wheels for the Ferrari 296 GTB and Ferrari 296 GTS combine lightweight forged construction, exceptional strength, and a design specifically developed to complement Ferrari's hybrid supercar platform. body: The Novitec Hydraulic Nose Lift System for the Ferrari 296 GTB / GTS is designed to combine a lower, more dynamic stance with everyday usability. This complete suspension upgrade includes a Novitec suspension spring set for lowering in combination with the original suspension, while the hydraulic front axle lift allows the nose of the car to be raised by 40mm at the push of a button. This makes it easier to clear speed bumps, steep driveways, parking garages, and other obstacles without compromising the lowered appearance and performance-focused setup of the car. Often referred to as a Ferrari 296 nose lift or front lift system, this upgrade adds practical ground clearance while retaining the original Ferrari damper adjustment. Available versions The Novitec Hydraulic Lift System is available in two versions, depending on the vehicle specification: F5 296 30: For Ferrari 296 GTB / GTS models with Fiorano Package F5 296 40: For Ferrari 296 GTB / GTS models without Fiorano Package 40mm hydraulic nose lift With the integrated hydraulic nose lift system, the front axle can be raised by 40mm at the push of a button. This gives the Ferrari 296 additional ground clearance when needed, while allowing the car to maintain its lowered Novitec stance during normal driving. The included CAN control unit ensures seamless integration with the vehicle electronics. The system is engineered specifically for the Ferrari 296 GTB and GTS, offering precise fitment and reliable operation. title: BAAN Air Suspension Lowering Links for Porsche Macan Electric
body: BAAN Air Suspension Lowering Links for Porsche Macan Electric are developed by BaanVelgen for the Porsche Macan Electric equipped with factory adaptive air suspension. Refine the stance of your Porsche Macan Electric without replacing the factory suspension system. BAAN Lowering Links provide a precise mechanical way to reduce wheel gap while keeping the original suspension controls available. Key benefits for the Macan Electric Complete vehicle-specific solution: The price includes a complete vehicle-specific lowering-link set for the front and rear axles. Adjustable while installed: opposing left-hand and right-hand threads allow fine adjustment by rotating the central adjuster while the links remain connected to the vehicle. Corrosion-resistant construction: precision-machined aluminium adjusters are combined with stainless-steel link ends and ball-joint sockets for exposed underbody use. Secure mechanical retention: locking nuts secure the selected length and dual metal safety-retaining clips help keep the sockets connected to the factory sensor balls. title: Akrapovic Slip on exhaust system | Porsche Cayman GT4
body: Akrapovic has spent months developing a Slip-On exhaust system that takes the driving experience to a completely new level for the Porsche Cayman GT4 . The fully titanium exhaust system with three muffler configurations saves weight at the rear axle, additionally enhancing the handling with more power and torque gained with improved gas-flow dynamics, reduced back pressure, and a more linear power curve. Power gains are especially noticeable in the mid range. All these pluses are rounded off by a thoroughly pleasing sound note. Thanks to the dual-mode exhaust flap system, the “cat-back” Slip-On enhances the unmistakably deep resonant sound of Akrapovič. Either you leave it to the car’s ECU to choose the noise level, or you select it yourself by pressing the button of the optional Akrapovic sound kit when it’s time to experience the passion.

title: Akrapovic Evolution exhaust | Audi S7 C7 Sportback
body: The Audi S7 C7 range of cars features high-performance V8 engines that are a perfect match for the Akrapovič Evolution exhaust systems.Styled and designed in-house by Akrapovic ’s engineers, the Audi S range of Evolution exhausts include valves that are steered through electric actuators designed to alter their position depending on the vehicle’s driving program and the driver’s style. They can also be changed in the car’s individual program settings. The addition of an Evolution exhaust will increase power and torque levels, while decreasing weight and adding the unique Akrapovič sound. Evolution exhausts give the car a noticeably different character, with a deep sound at lower revs and a sportier note as the revs rise. With four, superbly styled round carbon-fibre tailpipes, the Evolution system looks as good as it works on Audi S models. This cat-back performance exhaust system leaves the stock catalytic converters in place, so there is no need to remap the ECU. Its easy-to-fit instructions make installation a simple, plug-and play task.

body: KW HLS (Hydraulic Lift System 2) for Porsche 991 Turbo Helping lowered and low vehicles as the Porsche 991 Turbo to avoid road clearance difficulties. title: Capristo Exhaust Valve | Ferrari 355
body: Make: Ferrari Model:355 Material: 309 grade stainless steel Ferrari F355 Capristo exhaust valve This kit solves a known problem of the Ferrari 355 models. The original exhaust valves of the 355 need back pressure to be completely open. If there is any leak in the back pressure system (porous tube, etc.) this would lead to the loss of the required back pressure and result in the original valves being unable to open anymore. The Capristo replacement kit includes an exhaust valve that works the other way around and, if there should be any defects in the back pressure system it would automatically open, and stay open. In addition, it also has our patented, free-from-play mounting, which also guarantees an optimal and vibration-free performance at high temperatures. In addition, the kit also includes an electromagnetic valve, back pressure tube, two sealing rings and vacuum devices with heat protectors.

title: BAAN Air Suspension Lowering Links for Porsche Macan
body: BAAN Air Suspension Lowering Links for Porsche Macan are developed by BaanVelgen for the Porsche Macan equipped with factory air suspension. Refine the stance of your Porsche Macan without replacing the factory suspension system. BAAN Lowering Links provide a precise mechanical way to reduce wheel gap while keeping the original suspension controls available. Key benefits for the Macan Complete vehicle-specific solution: The price includes a complete vehicle-specific lowering-link set for the front and rear axles. Adjustable while installed: opposing left-hand and right-hand threads allow fine adjustment by rotating the central adjuster while the links remain connected to the vehicle. Corrosion-resistant construction: precision-machined aluminium adjusters are combined with stainless-steel link ends and ball-joint sockets for exposed underbody use. Secure mechanical retention: locking nuts secure the selected length and dual metal safety-retaining clips help keep the sockets connected to the factory sensor balls. No coding or electronic module: the links mechanically change the ride-height sensor reference without adding a controller to the vehicle wiring. Reversible installation: the original sensor links can be reinstalled to return the vehicle to its original configuration. Macan lowering range Front axle 0 to approximately 70 mm lower Rear axle 0 to approximately 80 mm lower Front and rear settings can be fine-tuned independently where applicable. The final measured ride height depends on the original vehicle calibration, suspension mode, vehicle load, tyre pressure and wheel-and-tyre configuration. Substantial lowering should be assessed for tyre clearance, suspension travel and road suitability. Technical specifications Brand BAAN Lowering Links Developed by BaanVelgen Development location Rotterdam, the Netherlands Production Precision-manufactured in Taiwan to BaanVelgen specifications Vehicle Porsche Macan Suspension compatibility factory air suspension Central adjuster Precision-machined aluminium with anti-slip knurling Link ends and sockets Corrosion-resistant stainless steel Adjustment mechanism Opposing left-hand and right-hand threads; adjustable on the car Retention system Mechanical locking nuts and dual metal safety-retaining clips Dimensional inspection Critical dimensions inspected using measuring equipment with a resolution of 0.001 mm Coding required No Installation Reversible, vehicle-specific replacement of the factory sensor links How BAAN Lowering Links work The factory ride-height sensors measure suspension position through short mechanical links. Replacing the fixed original links with adjustable BAAN links changes the mechanical reference supplied to the suspension controller. The vehicle then maintains a lower static position without software coding or an electronic signal-interception module. title: Akrapovic Sports Cup Line exhaust system | Porsche 991 GT3 (RS)
body: Akrapovic Sports Cup Line exhaust system for Porsche 991 GT3 (RS) The Akrapovič Sports Cup exhaust system is based on the Porsche Sports Cup rules, which state that the original exhaust manifold with integrated catalytic convertors must be retained. Akrapovic therefore developed a performance and weight-optimized titanium end muffler with appropriate link pipes as the connecting piece to the manifold for the Porsche 991 GT3 . This kind of construction reduces the weight dramatically in comparison to the original exhaust system . The weight distribution of the vehicle is improved considerably because of the weight reduction in the area behind the engine and the rear axle, which has an extremely positive effect on the handling . The look of this system with a deep racing sound is completed with a set of titanium tailpipes . The package contains: - titanium end muffler - titanium tailpipes, - fitting material

title: Akrapovic Slip on exhaust system | Porsche 991 GT3 (RS)
body: Akrapovic Slip on exhaust system for Porsche 991 GT3 (RS) The Akrapovič Slip-On system is based on the same layout as the original exhaust system of the GT3 with valve control. The Slip-On contains a titanium muffler with two double round tailpipes. The muffler is easily installed on the original exhaust system. The Akrapovič Slip-On makes the Porsche 991 GT3 more powerful and lighter, even though the exhaust system is not replaced entirely. The sound of its six-valve engine is also noticeably improved. The Slip-On exhaust system offers weight reduction in the rear of the Porsche and an increase in power. Two tailpipes , 100 mm in diameter, make it clear that the Akrapovič Slip-On system is no ordinary exhaust The package contains: - Titanium Muffler - titanium tailpipes, - fitting material

title: TMP Pro Spacers | Tesla Model S
body: PRO-SPACER | Wheel Spacers for Tesla Model S Widen your stance—for better handling and appearance Made from high-tensile-strength aluminum alloy Exact fitment by using minimal production tolerances, resulting in exceptional wheel balance All applications tested in rigid durability- and fatigue tests High-grade corrosion protection through a special coating process (salt spray test according to DIN 50021) Significant weight advantage compared to wheel-spacers made from steel With the Pro-Spacer installed, the car looks wider and better, as the wheel fills the arch. That’s how the car’s look gets its final touch. By increasing the track width, not only the appearance is improved, but you also achieve an optimized driving behavior combined with higher stability, as the roll of the chassis is influenced in a positive manner. As this system includes new low profile wheelbolts to enable you to fix the wheel spacers to your hub it incorporates new bolt holes in the wheel spacer so do not need to replace your existing wheel bolts so it’s a quick and easy way to enhance the look of your car. You can use your existing wheel bolts and locking wheel bolts. Multiple wheel spacer widths are available for most vehicles. To select the right Pro Spacers for your vehicle, measure the gap between your tire wall and the face of the wheel well fender (in millimeters). **Since eibach decided not to produce these spacers for Tesla, we deliver them from TMP all tüv approved.

body: Akrapovic titanium Slip On exhaust system | BMW F82 M4 The latest addition to the BMW M series is the awe-inspiring BMW M4 , an exquisite high-performance car that can be made even better by adding an Akrapovič Slip-On exhaust system. Made from titanium—with some parts cast in Akrapovič’s own foundry—it has bigger pipes than the stock exhaust, yielding lower back pressure and more power, especially at lower RPMs. This system is a completely new design, and it will reduce overall vehicle weight and deliver extra power and a sporty sound, which has been tailored to highlight lower frequencies and increase the listening enjoyment. Increases in both power and torque add to the sensory experience, combined with improved agility With tailpipes in titanium or carbon , and a handcrafted rear diffuser , all available as optional extras , the BMW Evolution is as beautiful as it is powerful

title: Akrapovic Titanium Tailpipe set | BMW F82 M4
body: Akrapovic titanium tailpipe set | BMW F82 M4 As the most visible part of an exhaust system , we pay the utmost attention to the tailpipes. Akrapovič has created special titanium tailpipes to enrich the visual enjoyment of the Slip-On or Evolution exhaust systems for the BMW M4 . Sporting the unique Akrapovič round design, the titanium version combines polished and sandblasted titanium and a bigger diameter than stock tailpipes to make them stand out from the crowd even more. The new model was unveiled with distinctive Akrapovič design elements, and these beautifully crafted additions are designed to fit perfectly with the carbon- diffuser.

title: Akrapovic Rear Carbon Diffuser | BMW F82 M4
body: Akrapovic Carbon rear diffuser | BMW F82 M4 The Akrapovič Evolution and Slip-On line exhaust systems can be further enhanced with an optional hand-crafted carbon-fiber rear diffuser . Developed by Akrapovič ’s R&D Department, this stunning diffuser, crafted from materials developed through Akrapovič’s racing involvement, is designed to perfectly fit the lines of the unique tailpipes of the Slip-On or Evolution systems, as well as complement the sleek and sporty shape of the BMW M4 .

title: Akrapovic Evolution Link Pipe Set | BMW F82 M4
body: Akrapovic titanium Evolution exhaust system | BMW F82 M4 The Evolution performance exhaust system for the BMW F82 M4 consists of a single-central muffler with valves and bigger link pipe tubes with a middle muffler, all designed to make the performance and workmanship of the Evolution as perfect as its looks. With no second set of cats — (unlike the stock BMW Exhaust system), the whole system is designed to give the smoothest flow to the BMW M4 —and the power and torque gains of the BMW with the Evolution system are simply amazing. Crafted entirely from titanium, the Evolution system has a unique sound to complement its substantial increase over a very wide rpm range. In-depth engineering has produced a sound completely different from the stock system, giving a deep and sporty sound – with no unwanted overtones or drone, and also a significant change to the sound with the valves in the open or closed positions. The Evolution system needs no re-programming of the ECU because it doesn’t trigger any warning lights With tailpipes in titanium or carbon , and a handcrafted rear diffuser , all available as optional extras , the BMW Evolution is as beautiful as it is powerful.

title: Ohlins Road and Track BMW M3 E92
body: Ohlins Road and Track for BMW M3 E92 Designed to improve the performance and comfort of your car. With Ohlins DNA integrated throughout, this suspension is the must have upgrade for your E92 M3. Ohlins Road & Track suspension with DFV (Dual Flow Valve) technology is the best suspension system on today's market that can be used on the street and track. With DFV , the dual flow valve gives the same characteristics on rebound as it does on compression, thanks to the damper fluid having a consistent path of flow in both directions. This means that the wheel and tire can quickly and effectively resume their important position back on the ground, providing grip and traction. The new Ohlins R&T range uses DFV technology on every single fitment, making it the perfect upgrade for the enthusiast that needs comfort and agility in one unit. body: Porsche Panamera 971 Turbo S E-hybrid | Akrapovic evolution exhaust We made no compromises when developing the new Evolution exhaust system for this four-door sporty limousine. This new aftermarket system is noticeably louder, with a deep and very aggressive sound, to fully express the racing-oriented nature of this exhaust, which is made from our proprietary titanium alloy. This complete beautifully crafted titanium system consists of four round tail pipes, computer-optimized asymmetrical mufflers with a “dual mode” exhaust valve system, and a link pipe with a resonator to eliminate any chance of in-cabin droning. When using the Akrapovič installation kit, the exhaust valves of the “dual mode” system can be fixed in open or closed position. To experience the full potential of the Evolution exhaust system, we developed an optional wireless control kit. With a simple press of a button, the driver can close or open the flaps to choose between a loud racy sound or a quieter note for long-distance driving. When the valves are open the gas flow bypasses the mufflers. Performance This Evolution system not only transforms the Panamera’s nature with a racing look and especially its sound, but also adds more power and torque, improves power distribution, and also helps reduce weight. The Evolution system is perfect and has a leak-free fit. Because it is ECE type approved with no need to remap the ECU or add any other parts, it is just a simple plug-and-play installation. The exquisite Akrapovič Evolution Line (Titanium) exhaust system adds performance and style, along with an amazing soundtrack. For vehicles with the base (non sport) Porsche exhaust system, which is then replaced by the Akrapovič Evolution Line system, the Middle Valve Actuator Kit is a mandatory upgrade. This product will not fit on Executive models.

title: BBS CH-R II "satin black" // 21 inch
body: Two-piece in the summer - The CH-R II Wheel design raised the CH-R to a new level With the two-piece wheel design CH-R II , the Schiltach-based premium manufacturer BBS raises its classic and proven CH-R to a new level, and is thus in an excellent position for the summer. The two-piece design of the wheel allows for previously unknown perspectives. For decades, demanding customers and car manufacturers have relied on light alloy wheels made by BBS. No design embodies the values of the Schiltach traditional brand in this context as much as the famous premium wheel CH-R. At the Geneva Motor Show, BBS now presents the completely revised two-piece variant CH-R II. The structure of the wheel with a wheel well and a separate star hubs for the front and rear axles opens special design options for the consumer. The wheel wells of the CH-R II are unique in the industry and make a considerable weight optimization possible. Long, thin spokes and a very small center area give the CH-R design its equally timeless and dynamic appearance. The two-piece CH-R II design combines the design language of the bestseller with the latest technology from motor sport in an optimal way. Like its one-piece counterpart, the CH-R II is also subjected to flow-forming after production in the low-pressure casting process. This high-quality rotary rolling process allows the production of particularly light and strong wheels. In addition, the CH-R II features milled spokes to achieve maximum weight savings without sacrificing structural stability. The proven BBS collision protection and a laser inscription in the star hub provide for additional enhancement of the wheel. The wheel well of the CH-R II is available in the color satin titanium , the star hub in satin black , and can be ordered in 21 inch in sizes 9x21, 9.5x21, 10x21, 10.5x21 and 11x21 inches. Available for Audi, Porsche and BMW About BBS: BBS is the world's most well-known brand for light alloy wheels. This is confirmed by awards from leading German and international automotive trade magazines. Careful controls guarantee the quality of products made by BBS, beginning with the heat treatment up to the surface finish. Each wheel produced isheat treated . This is crucial for the strength of the aluminum. BBS only uses environmentally friendly coatings. The coating method guarantees the OE quality of leading premium car manufacturers.

title: KW Top Mounts Camber plates Adjustable
body: KW TOP MOUNTS | CAMBER PLATES KW suspension Automotive can now offer this superb range of adjustable top mounts. KW Adjustable top mounts can be fitted whether you are using KW Automotive suspension kits or for your OEM suspension. The KW top mounts allow you to adjust the camber and castor angles on your vehicle (most applications) keeping the suspension geometry optimised for supreme handling Camber Adjustment The wider range of camber adjustment allows the reduction of excessive negative camber caused by lowering. That will improve tire wear. Camber may be adjusted to a much more negative setting for more front grip when cornering. Caster Adjustment KW Camber Plates provide adjustment of caster, which is otherwise not adjustable. Increasing the amount of positive caster improves straight-line stability. Increasing the amount of caster also helps increase front grip during cornering because additional cater causes an increase in negative camber on the outside tire when the car is steered into a corner. The increased negative camber increases cornering grip. The increase in negative camber is only present while the tire is steered, and therefore does not harm tire wear. Prices shown are 'per pair' of top mounts.

body: Stud & Lug nut conversion kits BMW For non race cars, stud conversions make wheel install and removal much easier as you do not have to line up the holes in your wheels, spacers, and hubs before hand threading in a single lug bolt. Simply slide the wheel onto the studs, and let go. Your wheel will no longer spin around the hub, but will instead be lined up correctly. Extended length studs like these allow for a range of spacers to be used without any additional modification. You can easily use 3, 5, 10, 12mm or no spacer at all. When using lug bolts with spacers you are forced to purchase a different length lug for each width spacer. Why own a bucket full of lugs when a single set of studs can do it all? By remaining installed, the studs put less ware on the threads of your hubs. They guarantee there is enough thread engagement, as you can see how many threads were engaged during install. Wheel studs replace your OEM lug bolts by simply threading into your cars hub. Once installed they do not need to be removed when changing or removing wheels. Only the lug bolts are removed similar to many domestic vehicles. Features: APEX Wheel studs are 10.9 grade steel, and produced in Europe by a TUV approved OEM supplier 75mm length allows for the use of spacers up to 12mm in thickness, or no spacer at all, without making any changes The studs have a bulletnose tip that makes lug nut install and removal easy, and prevents cross threading The head has an integrated 5.5mm hex to make initial installation a breeze The hardened studs are black zinc plated, while the nuts are available in both black and silver zinc plating Studs and nuts are 12x1.5 or 14x 1.25 thread depending on your vehicle with a 60 degree taper identical to OEM BMW hardware.

title: Capristo Exhaust valve-controlled | Audi RS6 C7 bi-turbo
body: Make: Audi Model: RS6 Submodel: C7 Bi-turbo Material: 309 grade stainless steel Valve controlled: Yes Performance gain: - Tip style: OEM Audi RS6 C7 Bi-turbo Capristo exhaust valved controlled This complete valve controlled exhaust racing system (Full System) is for Audi RS6 B7 No matter what you say, we all know the number one reason that we add an aftermarket exhaust system to our cars is for this aggressive and sporty sound. Just about every exhaust system on the market will add a few extra horsepower to your Audi, but what they won't do is make your car sound anywhere near as good as it will with a CAPRISTO Exhaust. This system is sold without a remote control system as it is not needed. The exhaust valves on the RS6 C7 exhaust system are controlled via the on-board Audi control system. If desired, the programmable remote system can be added. CAPRISTO offers a valved exhaust system, which compliments Audi's "best of both worlds" philosophy by producing an aggressive note under acceleration, but a more civil tone during stop and go driving. It does so by the use of vacuum-actuated flaps that open and close depending on driving conditions and input from the driver. When open, the valves allow gasses to escape through a second outlet from the muffler which facilitates a much larger volume of exhaust to freely pass through the muffler. This not only provides a much more aggressive sound, but also contributes to a noticeable increase in overall performance. However, even when the valves are closed, CAPRISTO 's Exhaust system has been defined as one of the best system if not the best for the Audi RS 6 . It does a much better job of allowing the real character of the AUDI V8 to be heard. The exhaust valves are back pressure-controlled via the on-board control system. Made of high-grade T309 stainless steel (close to Inconel properties) throughout the entire system and the entire system is then hand polished to a mirror finish.

body: Recaro Profi SPA racing seat Like the slightly smaller Recaro Pole Position, the Profi fixed-back racing seat is the ideal solution for the track day enthusiast, those new to motorsports or for those who want the ultimate support from their high-performance street car. This seat boasts an extended range of features and even greater durability. The professional glass fibre reinforced plastic (GRP) shell has special friction grip surfaces in the shoulder area that makes it an excellent choice for use in rallying and circuit racing. The Recaro Profi SPA Bucket seat has an integrated headrest for reliable head protection, especially designed shoulder support for optimum lateral hold and well-defined side contours for excellent support and friction grip surface in the shoulder and seat area. This seat also offers a higher lateral hold than the Profi SPG. Motorsport racing shells must stand up to the severest stresses and must, as it were, be tailored to the driver’s body, so that it can provide an excellent hold in the seat in all driving situations. A shell form which is correct for the body and individual padding of the seat cushions and backrest center form part of the basic comfort of all RECARO racing shells. They have proved themselves for over 25 years in motor sport and have been fine-tuned for this purpose. This wealth of experience and close cooperation with drivers and teams allow development progress in the area of safety and seat technology which more and more drivers are using to achieve success. title: 3DDesign Trunk spoiler | BMW F06 F13 M6
body: Car Model: F06, F13 M6 Design: Trunk spoiler Part No.: 3109-20621 Materials : Carbon Finishing: Carbon The 3DDesign Trunk Spoiler attaches to the rear trunk on BMW F06 M6 GranCoupe and BMW F13 M6 Coupe. About the product At first glance it is apparent that the 3D aero kit is one with the spirit of the BMW F12 F13 and F06 M6. Every piece of the aero program pays particular attention to the unique body lines of the chassis. The dips, curves, and twists are continued through each and every piece. While taking a closer look at the 3ddesign front lip, it is easy to notice how the line of the lip meticulously follows the lines of the front bumper prior to dropping into a subtle 2-piece splitter. The 3ddesign trunk spoiler takes on a more aggressive approach by borrowing some inspiration from the Moto GP BMW F10 M5. One of the most impressive aspects of the entire kit is the 3DDesignrear diffuser. The rear diffuser is aggressive, but tasteful. As a substitute for the approach of adding massive fins, 3D Design opted for a 2 piece bolt on lower section that beautifully frames the exhaust tips. The kit is rounded out with a carbon fiber bolt on side-skirt. About 3DDesign 3D Design was established in 1998 by a team with deep knowledge, expertise and proven technology through participation in various races of different categories, both in the domestic and international circuits. 3D Design's philosophy to strive for perfection and accuracy with less focus on time and cost of development is reflected in our quest to build the most attractive and efficient tuning components as well as dress-up parts for the niche BMW performance market.

title: KW coilover kit DDC ECU Plug & Play
body: KW DDC – Performance for racetrack & road The KW DDC (Dynamic Damping Control) coilover kit with ECU (Electronic Control Unit) was developed for individual lowering and installation of an electronic damping control system. The scope of delivery contains a KW inox-line coilover kit with electronically controlled dampers, a high-performance control unit, the car specific cable set with control switch and a detailed manual for an easy installation. The KW DDC coilover kit has three car specific developed damper settings. By the push of a button the driver can choose between the sport basic setup, a very sporty and performance-oriented Sport+ setup and the comfort mode for uneven/ poor road surfaces. The height adjustment of KW coilover kits also allow an individual lowering within the TÜV-tested adjustment range. Create your own setup ADVANCED In the ADVANCED menu the value of the damper strength is indicated in real-time. The infinitely variable damper setting occurs separately in front axle and rear axle in (+/-1%) or (+/-10%) in single steps. As soon as the individual set-up is configured within the KW safety regulations, it will be passed to the suspension control unit with the Transmit-button and is saved. With the activation of the feature „Constantly update“ the respective changes are be transfered within milliseconds to the dampers and you feel the differences immediately. PERSONAL In the PERSONAL menu you can save up to five individual setups for the dampers that additionally can be shared via e-mail. SETTINGS In the SETTINGS menu you change the look of the App. You can choose between different backgrounds and activate the logo.

title: KW Cancellation kit for electronic damping | EDC Delete Unit
body: KW Cancellation Kits Cancellation kits eliminate persistent trouble codes that exist when upgrading a suspension on a vehicle with electronically regulated dampers. KW is the only manufacturer that offers the solutions whereby the serial damper regulation is shut down and at the same time trouble code avoided. The functioning of the of the control unit remains completely intact.

title: KW HLS 4 (Hydraulic Lift System) including KW inox v3 coilover kit
body: KW HLS (Hydraulic Lift System 4) Helping lowered vehicles to avoid road clearance difficulties The HLS provides additional road clearance for lowered vehicles. When expanded, a range of up to 45 mm of lift is produced, thereby helping sport cars avoid road clearance difficulties such as speed bumps, road construction, etc. KW HLS is available as vehicle specific solution or individual conversion kit depending on the car model. HLS is available in two different versions: HLS 2 which is fitted to the front axle and HLS 4 which can be attached to the front and rear axle and allows lifting the entire vehicle. The hydraulic cylinder unit is located on the coilover body between spring perch and spring. The advantage of a hydraulic system is that there is no compression (motion) of the extended cylinder unit (resulting in no unwanted additional suspension movement) while driving. Allows cars with low ground clearance to clear obstacles more easily Available as complete kit including KW coilover kit or as conversion kit Can be activated from inside the vehicle via a LED position control switch or by an optional remote, thereby eliminating any need for interior wiring. Can be activated while driving (up to 80 km/h) Fast lifting – maximum lift occurs within 4-5 seconds when using HLS 2 High-quality cylinder unit with durable aluminium construction Sealed unit for corrosion and dirt resistance Depending on the car type and model, KW HLS is either available as a vehicle-specific solution or as a conversion kit for KW or OEM coilover kits existing of springs, adaptions, hydraulic cylinder and control unit.

When expanded, a range of up to 45 mm of lift is produced, thereby helping sport cars avoid road clearance difficulties such as speed bumps, road construction, etc. KW HLS is available as vehicle specific solution or individual conversion kit depending on the car model. HLS is available in two different versions: HLS 2 which is fitted to the front axle and HLS 4 which can be attached to the front and rear axle and allows lifting the entire vehicle. The hydraulic cylinder unit is located on the coilover body between spring perch and spring. The advantage of a hydraulic system is that there is no compression (motion) of the extended cylinder unit (resulting in no unwanted additional suspension movement) while driving. Allows cars with low ground clearance to clear obstacles more easily Available as complete kit including KW coilover kit or as conversion kit Can be activated from inside the vehicle via a LED position control switch or by an optional remote, thereby eliminating any need for interior wiring. Can be activated while driving (up to 80 km/h) Fast lifting – maximum lift occurs within 4-5 seconds when using HLS 2 High-quality cylinder unit with durable aluminium construction Sealed unit for corrosion and dirt resistance Depending on the car type and model, KW HLS is either available as a vehicle-specific solution or as a conversion kit for KW or OEM coilover kits existing of springs, adaptions, hydraulic cylinder and control unit.

title: KW Coilover sleeve spring kit for Porsche 991 S
body: KW Coilover sleeve spring kit The KW Coilover spring kit is used for lowering the vehicle in combination with the serial dampers, even when electronic damper control is installed. This lowering solution from KW optimises the dynamic performance and the steering behaviour without the electronic damper control deactivated. For this solution vehicle specific adjustable spring seats with adjusted KW lowering springs and the matching elastomer as well as the dust cover system will be used. This complete conversion allows an individual Adjustable lowering solution, Individual height adjustability of the serial suspension kit Serial suspension system also with electronic damper control stays active Improved optic and vehicle dynamics Optimal performance Better steering behaviour Not compatible with Porsche Dynamic Chassis Control (PDCC).

title: KW coilover kit DDC ECU
body: KW DDC – Performance for racetrack & road The KW DDC (Dynamic Damping Control) coilover kit with ECU (Electronic Control Unit) was developed for individual lowering and installation of an electronic damping control system. The scope of delivery contains a KW inox-line coilover kit with electronically controlled dampers, a high-performance control unit, the car specific cable set with control switch and a detailed manual for an easy installation. The KW DDC coilover kit has three car specific developed damper settings. By the push of a button the driver can choose between the sport basic setup, a very sporty and performance-oriented Sport+ setup and the comfort mode for uneven/ poor road surfaces. The height adjustment of KW coilover kits also allow an individual lowering within the TÜV-tested adjustment range. Create your own setup ADVANCED In the ADVANCED menu the value of the damper strength is indicated in real-time. The infinitely variable damper setting occurs separately in front axle and rear axle in (+/-1%) or (+/-10%) in single steps. As soon as the individual set-up is configured within the KW safety regulations, it will be passed to the suspension control unit with the Transmit-button and is saved. With the activation of the feature „Constantly update“ the respective changes are be transfered within milliseconds to the dampers and you feel the differences immediately. PERSONAL In the PERSONAL menu you can save up to five individual setups for the dampers that additionally can be shared via e-mail. title: Akrapovic Slip-On exhaust system | Porsche 981 Boxster | S | GTS

options.name: Add Sound Kit (mandatory for non-sport exhaust replacement)

body: Akrapovic Slip-On exhaust system for Porsche 981 Boxster (S / GTS) Engineers have spent months developing a Slip-On exhaust system that takes the driving experience to a completely new level. This fully titanium exhaust system with three muffler configurations saves weight at the rear axle, additionally enhancing the handling with more power and torque gained with improved gas-flow dynamics, reduced back pressure, and a more linear power curve. Power gains are especially noticeable in the mid range. All these pluses are rounded off by a thoroughly pleasing sound note. Thanks to the dual-mode exhaust flap system, the “cat-back” Slip-On enhances the unmistakably deep resonant sound of Akrapovič. Either you leave it to the car’s ECU to choose the noise level, or you select it yourself by pressing the button of the optional Wireless Kit when it’s time to experience the passion. If the stock system does not have integrated exhaust valves, the wireless kit is mandatory. If the stock system has integrated exhaust valves (the Porsche sport exhaust), no wireless kit is needed.

title: Akrapovic Evolution exhaust system // BMW F30 335i
body: The Akrapovic Evolution exhaust systems for the BMW F30 335i are the result of the perfect integration of expertise, the best technology, and the use of the finest materials. Made of austenitic stainless steel , these systems feature a newly developed layout with two central link pipes replacing the single stock pipe, a new muffler design, and carbon fibre tailpipes . This sporty elegance makes this Bavarian machine stand out from the rest and offers the taste of a more powerful version, accentuated with the additional power gains and weight losses of the Evolution system. The dual-mode ECU-controlled valve exhaust from Akrapovič offers stock-level sound at normal cruising, and a joyful deep sporty note when driving the 335i more dynamically. The Evolution systems replace the stock exhaust from the catalytic converters back. Hard facts: plus 7.1 HP (at 5.850 rpm) plus 10.7 Nm (at 3.500 rpm) The package contains: - Stainless steel mufflers, - Central link pipe, - collector - titanium or carbon tailpipes - fitting material

title: Evolution exhaust system // Mercedes Benz SLS AMG
body: Akrapovič has crafted a high-performance titanium Evolution exhaust system to further enhance this legendary performance car with a massive 6.3-liter V8. Made of our proprietary titanium alloy, the Evolution exhaust system is a “cat back” system. There are significant weight savings that aid handling and the power improvement is delivered across the rev range. The system further enhances the driving experience with the famed unmistakable deep resonant sound of Akrapovič, which is controlled with a Wireless kit for exhaust valve control. When the valves are open, this powerful machine roars like a typical V8 muscle car. Complete the look with a pair of stunning handcrafted carbon fibre tailpipes with a special titanium alloy core. Hard facts: Plus 12.4 HP (at 5.820 rpm) Plus 13.4 Nm/9.9 lbs-ft of torque (at 5,720 rpm) 12.4 kg/27.3lbs. lighter than stock The package contains: - titanium mufflers, - set of 100 cpsi catalists - Carbon tailpipes - fitting material

title: Akrapovic Evolution exhaust system // Mercedes Benz C63 AMG (C204 / W204 / S204)
body: Stepping up to our Evolution system, there are further gains to be had in terms of power delivery and weight reduction for the C 63 AMG. The sound is also deeper and more aggressive. The Evolution system is notably louder than the Slip-On, but it’s still perfectly suitable for day-to-day driving. The Evolution system is precision-made of our proprietary titanium: we include the mufflers from the Slip-On system and then add a lightweight link pipe assembly that incorporates integrated resonators. The mounting points are the same and the system fits perfectly. Complete the look with a set of four unique tailpipes in titanium. The bezels for these tailpipes are cast at our foundry from an exclusive blend of titanium, as are the collectors for the mufflers. Hard facts: Plus 11 HP (at 3,550 rpm) Plus 22 Nm/16 lbs-ft of torque (at 3,720 rpm) 19.3 kg/42.5 lbs. lighter than stock The package contains: - titanium mufflers, - set of 100 cpsi catalists - titanium tailpipes - fitting material

title: Capristo Exhaust valve-controlled | Lamborghini Gallardo LP550, LP560 & LP570
body: Make: Lamborghini Model: Gallardo Submodel: LP550, LP560 & LP570 Material: 309 grade stainless steel Valve controlled: Yes Performance gain: - Tip style: Round Part number: 02 LA 068 03 006 Lamborghini Gallardo Capristo exhaust valved controlled This complete valve controlled exhaust racing system (Full System) is for Lamborghini Gallardo LP 550, LP560 & LP570 Lamborghini Gallardo Twin Sound System A state of the art design for a perfect fit to your Lamborghini Gallardo, This Twin Sound system is the best choice to enhance the unique V10 sound. You will experience an increase in horsepower and sound due to a more efficient flow through the exhaust system. This exhaust system can be installed directly into its existing mounting points. The original vacuum pipes fit directly into the Capristo valve system. The opening or closing of the valves are controlled by the vehicle ECU, therefore working the same way that the original exhaust was designed to function. A wireless remote control is optional with this system . It has the ability to open and close the valves at a touch of a button. This allows you the choice of opening the exhaust valves at will, letting out the full Gallardo sound. A optional Programmable remote controller is also available. The exhaust valves are back pressure-controlled and user programmable. A built in limit prevents reaching dangerous pressure levels. There is a control unit for monitoring the back pressure. This control unit provides the ability to individually program the back pressure one would like to have the valves open or close. The portion of back pressure resulting in a loss of performance is filtered out. This way, one can reach the maximum performance. Therefore, this sports exhaust combines all advantages in both the lower and higher range of revolutions (rpm), since the back pressure can be exactly controlled to enable the engine to gain the maximum performance. The programmable control unit features an illuminated display showing all functions in plain text in 3 different languages (German, English and Italian) and provides 3 basic modes to be operated via a remote control, namely: Cruise mode - the exhaust gas valves open later Sports mode - the exhaust gas valves open earlier Open mode - the exhaust gas valves remain open In both the cruise mode and sport mode, one can individually program when the exhaust gas valves shall open. One big advantage is that the control unit recognizes the driver’s operation characteristics. If the driver accelerates aggressively, this is identified by our device by the kind of back pressure that is generated, and the exhaust gas valves open immediately. Usual acceleration results in a later opening of the exhaust gas valves. title: KW HLS (Hydraulic Lift System)
body: KW HLS (Hydraulic Lift System) Helping lowered vehicles to avoid road clearance difficulties The HLS provides additional road clearance for lowered vehicles. When expanded, a range of up to 45 mm of lift is produced, thereby helping sport cars avoid road clearance difficulties such as speed bumps, road construction, etc. KW HLS is available as vehicle specific solution or individual conversion kit depending on the car model. HLS is available in two different versions: HLS 2 which is fitted to the front axle and HLS 4 which can be attached to the front and rear axle and allows lifting the entire vehicle. The hydraulic cylinder unit is located on the coilover body between spring perch and spring. The advantage of a hydraulic system is that there is no compression (motion) of the extended cylinder unit (resulting in no unwanted additional suspension movement) while driving. Allows cars with low ground clearance to clear obstacles more easily Available as complete kit including KW coilover kit or as conversion kit Can be activated from inside the vehicle via a LED position control switch or by an optional remote, thereby eliminating any need for interior wiring. Can be activated while driving (up to 80 km/h) Fast lifting – maximum lift occurs within 4-5 seconds when using HLS 2 High-quality cylinder unit with durable aluminium construction Sealed unit for corrosion and dirt resistance Depending on the car type and model, KW HLS is either available as a vehicle-specific solution or as a conversion kit for KW or OEM coilover kits existing of springs, adaptions, hydraulic cylinder and control unit.

title: Akrapovic Evolution Exhaust System // BMW M6 F12 F13
body: The Akrapovic Evolution system lowers the back pressure and gives the BMW F12 M6 more power and torque through the whole range of rpms. It increases responsiveness. The Evolution system offers an even greater difference in weight, improving the power-to-weight ratio. Gains are achieved without removing the catalytic converters. While developing this system, Akrapovic especially focused on sound. An F13 M6 with the Evolution system delivers a deep, aggressive roar when driven hard, coaxing bangs out of the unique tail pipes when shifting and going off the throttle. To top it all off, the Evolution system is drone free and works well with the M6's Active Noise Cancellation system—just like the valve system, which is regulated through the M6’s settings. Hard facts: plus 10 HP (at 5.950 rpm) plus 17 Nm (at 5.200 rpm) minus 12.3kg The package contains: - titanium dual-oulet mufflers, - titanium X-shaped pipes with resonators - titanium or carbon tailpipes, - fitting material

title: BBS CH-R // 19 inch
body: Size: 19x8.5 ET51 PCD5x130 – Front 19x10.0 ET38 PCD5x130 - Rear Finish: Matt Black Matt Antracite Bright Silver Design The CH-R wheel incorporates the long and angled spoke design developed for the legendary BBS GT wheels in Motorsport. Combined with a very efficient center spoke region, this wheel design is a tremendous blend of strength and weight. Technology Incorporating technology from the development of Formula 1, we can produce wheels with less weight for a given strength. The CH-R wheel utilizes a cast and special flow forming process that produces an extremely strong but light weight wheel even for heavy load vehicles. Separating from its sister, the CH, the back milled spokes provide greater weight and strength optimization. Specific features The CH-R wheel incorporates the words “Motorsport” into the front face providing a unique characteristic of this wheel while paying respects to the decades of success in Motorsport. title: KW coilover kit DDC ECU
body: KW DDC – Performance for racetrack & road The KW DDC (Dynamic Damping Control) coilover kit with ECU (Electronic Control Unit) was developed for individual lowering and installation of an electronic damping control system. The scope of delivery contains a KW inox-line coilover kit with electronically controlled dampers, a high-performance control unit, the car specific cable set with control switch and a detailed manual for an easy installation. The KW DDC coilover kit has three car specific developed damper settings. By the push of a button the driver can choose between the sport basic setup, a very sporty and performance-oriented Sport+ setup and the comfort mode for uneven/ poor road surfaces. The height adjustment of KW coilover kits also allow an individual lowering within the TÜV-tested adjustment range. Create your own setup ADVANCED In the ADVANCED menu the value of the damper strength is indicated in real-time. The infinitely variable damper setting occurs separately in front axle and rear axle in (+/-1%) or (+/-10%) in single steps. As soon as the individual set-up is configured within the KW safety regulations, it will be passed to the suspension control unit with the Transmit-button and is saved. With the activation of the feature „Constantly update“ the respective changes are be transfered within milliseconds to the dampers and you feel the differences immediately. PERSONAL In the PERSONAL menu you can save up to five individual setups for the dampers that additionally can be shared via e-mail. SETTINGS In the SETTINGS menu you change the look of the App. You can choose between different backgrounds and activate the logo.

title: BBS CH-R // 20 inch
body: Size: 20x8.0 ET36 PDC 5x120 – Front 20x9.0 ET44 PDC 5x120 – Rear Finish: Matt Black Matt Antracite Bright Silver Design The CH-R wheel incorporates the long and angled spoke design developed for the legendary BBS GT wheels in Motorsport. Combined with a very efficient center spoke region, this wheel design is a tremendous blend of strength and weight. Technology Incorporating technology from the development of Formula 1, we can produce wheels with less weight for a given strength. The CH-R wheel utilizes a cast and special flow forming process that produces an extremely strong but light weight wheel even for heavy load vehicles. Separating from its sister, the CH, the back milled spokes provide greater weight and strength optimization. Specific features The CH-R wheel incorporates the words “Motorsport” into the front face providing a unique characteristic of this wheel while paying respects to the decades of success in Motorsport. The stainless rim protector can easily be changed in case of damage and provides an ideal way to make your rims look like new again or personalize.

body: Performance Springs #1 Choice of Automotive Enthusiasts Worldwide! Top-Performance Handling Lower centre of gravity – Lowers vehicle up to 1.5″ (40 mm) Progressive spring design Excellent ride quality Part of the Bilstein B12 Pro-Kit The Eibach Pro-Kit is the perfect answer for most popular street cars. The legendary spring system that dramatically improves both a vehicle’s performance and appearance. The Pro-Kit lowers your car’s centre of gravity , reducing squat during acceleration, body roll in corners and excessive nosedive under braking. When combined with Plus-1 or Plus-2 wheels and tyres, the Eibach Pro-Kit is the finishing touch to a winning recipe for performance. The Pro-Kit also reduces excessive fender well clearance , making your car look just as hot as it performs. Every Eibach Pro-Kit is designed and tested by Eibach suspension engineers and performance driving professionals, to deliver aggressive good looks and high performance handling, without ever compromising safety or ride quality.

body: BBS Le Mans (LM) wheels in 19 inch for the Porsche 911 997 Widebody (including Carrera 4S and Turbo) combine iconic motorsport heritage with precision-engineered performance. Originally derived from BBS endurance racing wheels used in the 24 Hours of Le Mans , the LM features a two-piece construction with a forged center and precision-machined outer rim. This results in exceptional strength, refined weight distribution, and a timeless design that perfectly complements the Porsche 997 platform. Combined with its motorsport heritage, the LM remains one of the most recognizable and respected wheel designs in the automotive world. body: Model: 3 pieces wheel Design: 5 spokes design Hubcap: Black carbon fibre hubcap Finishing: Hand Polished Dimensions: 19" - 20" - 22" Production process: Forged flange, cast inner rim, Spinned outer rim Materials : Flange: EN AW-6082 Inner rim:Al Si 7 Mg Outer rim: Anticorodal EN AW-6082 About OZ Racing wheels Since creating its first wheels in 1971, O.Z. Racing has established itself as a leader in the world's light alloy wheel industry. O.Z. Racing produces standard equipment wheels for some of the most exclusive automobiles in the world including Ferrari, Lamborghini, Maserati, Aston Martin and Lotus. The Italian company also fills the needs of prestigious automotive equipment and bodywork companies like Bertone, Pininfarina, AMG, Hartge, Callaway, Schnitzer, Cizeta, Strosek and Giugiaro. A look inside the high technology design and manufacturing facilities of Ruote O.Z. Racing s.p.a. in Italy will unveil what it takes to create an O.Z. Racing wheel that is a winner on the highway and the race track. Each stage of production focuses on creating a stronger, more beautiful wheel and this commitment has earned them more titles in motorsports than any other brand, including Indy 500/IRL, LeMans Series and Formula 1 Grand Prix wins as well as World Rally Championships and more. O.Z. Racing never compromises on quality and complies with all official regulations of their client countries, including the stringent rules of T.U.V., the German control office. O.Z. Racing constantly submits their wheels to multiple comprehensive testing to measure road stress. And to detect minute flaws, wheels are put under pressure in a specially designed water tank and scanned for hidden flaws by X-ray. Further examination is done by computer and electron microscopes. Finally, an anti-corrosion treatment is given, followed by a protective lacquer coating and final cleaning. A Lap on the Nurburgring O.Z.'s pursuit of excellence is not limited to advanced manufacturing processes; every O.Z. wheel design is taken for simulated laps on the famous Nurburgring circuit. This is done with a biaxial test machine. The test simulation standard is guaranteed via a license released by the German research institute LBF Fraunhofer and is the most complete and the closest simulation of the harshest conditions wheels may experience. The machine simulates the radial forces, the axial forces, the accelerations, the decelerations and the road surface variations that the wheels would experience on the Nurburgring circuit for 22,000 miles. Even if not necessary for homologation purposes, O.Z. uses the experience acquired through the daily use of this machine to develop and further improve its wheels O.Z. Racing wheels — the combination of elegant design, the latest manufacturing technology and scientific precision creating a winning harmony between the beauty of form and the quality of function that is the trademark of O.Z. Racing.
