title: Akrapovic header Porsche 992 GT3 (Touring)
body: Akrapovic evolution header set for the Porsche 992 GT3. The Evolution Header Set (E-PO/T/7) from Titanium for the Porsche 992 GT3 including the touring model. With the special Akrapovic manifold crossover pipes in the headers, this innovative design comes directly from race-proven exhaust systems. This is the first time it has featured in an Akrapovic car exhaust. The Akrapovic masterpiece of engineering is designed to optimize the performance of the Porsche 992 GT3. The headers will and fit to the OEM muffler or can be combined to most aftermarket exhaust mufflers. The headers are cast in the in-house foundry, and the complete use of titanium results in a weight saving of 3.8 kg, which is 28% lighter than the stock equivalent. Tuned quarter-length resonators with the sport catalytic converters ensure the sound quality and the absence of any distortion or unwanted frequencies. This is creating a unique sound experience for the Porsche 992 GT3. It provides an increases of 16.6 kW (22.6 hp) in power at 4,550 rpm and 35.2 Nm in torque at 4,500 rpm, when tested on the Akrapovic dyno against a Porsche 992 GT3 with the standard OEM stock exhaust. The system fits on vehicles equipped with and without Otto particulate filter (OPF). When installing the Akrapovic Evolution Header Set on vehicles with particulate filters, remapping the ECU is mandatory to prevent potential check engine light CEL warning signals. When installing the Akrapovic Evolution Header Set on vehicles without particulate filters, remapping the ECU is recommended but not required. You'll receive the Akrapovic Evolution Header Set (E-PO/T/7). This system will fit on the following Porsche models: 992.1 GT3 992.1 GT3 Touring 992.2 GT3 992.2 GT3 Touring

title: BAAN Air Suspension Lowering Links for BMW X7 G07
body: BAAN Air Suspension Lowering Links for BMW X7 G07 are developed by BaanVelgen for the BMW X7 G07 equipped with factory two-axle air suspension. Give the BMW X7 G07 a lower, cleaner profile while retaining the versatility of its original suspension system. BAAN Lowering Links combine model-specific fitment with straightforward mechanical adjustment. Key benefits for the X7 G07 Complete vehicle-specific solution: The price includes a complete vehicle-specific lowering-link set for the front and rear axles. Adjustable while installed: opposing left-hand and right-hand threads allow fine adjustment by rotating the central adjuster while the links remain connected to the vehicle. Corrosion-resistant construction: precision-machined aluminium adjusters are combined with stainless-steel link ends and ball-joint sockets for exposed underbody use. Secure mechanical retention: locking nuts secure the selected length and dual metal safety-retaining clips help keep the sockets connected to the factory sensor balls. No coding or electronic module: the links mechanically change the ride-height sensor reference without adding a controller to the vehicle wiring. Reversible installation: the original sensor links can be reinstalled to return the vehicle to its original configuration. X7 G07 lowering range Front axle 0 to approximately 50 mm lower Rear axle 0 to approximately 50 mm lower Front and rear settings can be fine-tuned independently where applicable. The final measured ride height depends on the original vehicle calibration, suspension mode, vehicle load, tyre pressure and wheel-and-tyre configuration. Substantial lowering should be assessed for tyre clearance, suspension travel and road suitability. title: Eibach Pro Spacers for Audi RSQ8
body: Eibach Wheel Spacers for Audi RSQ8 . By increasing the track width of the Audi RSQ8 you will achieve an optimized driving behavior combined with higher stability, as the roll of the chassis is influenced in a positive manner. And the wide arches of the RSQ8 just needs to be filled correctly, you only need the Eibach Pro-Spacer. It will fill the archers better, and give it that more agresive look, For the RSQ8 we offer the Eibach spacers in 12mm, 15mm and 20mm to get the perfect stance. The Eibach spacers are the available in anodised silver or anodised black and come with the required bolts. Optional you can select the mcgard locking bolts. Both front and rear have a hub-centering collar to help support the wheel. The 12mm and 15mm are fastened by using longer wheel bolts, the 20mm is first fastened to the car with special bolts which are included and then the wheel is installed with the original bolts.

body: MR magnesium wheels for the Porsche 991 GT3 RS and GT2 RS . The Manthey Racing wheels will give a total weigh reduction of an impressive 12.6kg. For the new wheel set suitable for the Porsche 991 GT3 RS Manthey Racing is using the design and technology being used in the Porsche 991 RSR which they raced in the season 2015 and won the WEC world championship. Their aim was to transform the technology from the race track to the street. Using the material Magnesium MR was able to drop the weight dramatically and save ±13kg compared to the original wheel set in similar size. The specific weight is 7.0 kg for the 9,5 x 20 offset 50 front and 9.5 kg for the 12,5 x 21 offset 48. The finishes we have available are Brilliant Silver, Satin Black, Titanium or Gold. We can also have them custom finished in basically any color, please contact us if you are interested in a custom finish. You will receive 4 wheels, 2 pieces for front BBS RE1640 9,5x20 ET50 GT3 RS mec 2 pieces for rear BBS RE1641 12,5x21 ET48 GT3 RS mec These wheels can be wrapped in your OEM standard Tires or a set of 265/35-20 and 325/30/21s, with the option of the following tire brand/models: Michelin Pilot Sport Cup 2 N (Porsche Spec) (Streetable Track & Competition Tire - OEM on Porsche GT3 RS) Pirelli Trofeo R (The Stickest Streetable Track & Competition Tire - OEM on the McLaren P1, and many other Hypercars) Other tyre brands and the Michelin CUP R and prices upon request

Manthey did it again together with BBS and made an ultralight wheel for the Porsche 992 GT3 and GT3 Touring, with an impressive weight saving of 7.3kg for the total wheelset. The reduction in the unsprung and rotating masses by 7.3 kg per wheel set is directly noticeably by the response behavior of the spring-damper elements and improves vehicle controllability even further. The colors available for the Porsche 992 GT3 are Manthey Racegold gloss (MT000155A) and Platinsilber Silver (MT000155B) You will receive 4 wheels, 2 pieces for front MR OM-1 9.5 J x 20 ET 46 2 pieces for rear MR OM-12 J x 21 ET 45 These wheels can be wrapped in your OEM standard Tires or a new set of 255/35 ZR 20 (97Y) XL front and 315/30 ZR 21 (105Y) XL, feel free to contact us for the options for wheel and tire packages.

title: iPE magnesium wheels MFR-01 Porsche 991 GT3 RS
body: iPE MFR-01 magnesium wheels for the Porsche 991 GT3 RS and GT2 RS . The IPE wheels forged from the highest grade Magnesium are the lightest wheels available for the 991 and 991.2 GT3 RS and GT2 RS. They will give a total weigh reduction of an impressive 13.8kg. Available in 9.5 x 20 ET50 and 12.5 x 21 ET48, in Satin Silver, Satin Black, champagne white gold and the limited edition in indigo blue. The specific weight is unbelievably light 6.9 kg for the 9,5 x 20 offset 50 front and 9.4 kg for the 12,5 x 21 offset 48. This will lower the unsprung weight and will improve accelerating, braking and the overall handling of the Porsche. You will receive 4 wheels, 2 pieces for front IPE MFR-01 9,5x20 ET50 2 pieces for rear IPE MFR-01 12,5x21 ET48 These wheels can be wrapped in your OEM standard Tires or a set of 265/35-20 and 325/30/21s, with the option of the following tire brand/models: - Michelin Pilot Sport Cup 2 N (Porsche Spec) (Streetable Track & Competition Tire - OEM on Porsche GT3 RS) - Other tyre brands and the Michelin CUP R and prices upon request

title: Brixton Forged PF14-RS
body: Brixton Forged PF14-RS wheels. The Brixton PF14-RS is a weight optimized 1-piece monoblock forged wheel suited as a performance upgrade for supercars. The RS-Series is a fusion of motorsport, engineering, and design all in one package. The series is a response to the question “What would we get if we utilized topological optimization, traditional FEA, and our own passion for design?”. The Brixton team dug into their CAD library and pulled out the top selling designs and applied the same formula, optimize + test + refine. The goal was to ultimately shave weight, and design a structurally optimized wheel with flawless surface transitions that is as artistic as it is technical. The result has been a series of wheels that follow the Brixton Forged ethos design leadership, ingenuity, and quality. Its our way of saying “they’re light, they’re new, they’re unique, and they look damn good”. Add the unique text & Groove Fill, add brand logo, text, and groove color fill options to your wheel set. Available in black, grey, white, red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple.

title: BC Forged KZ15 Monoblock Forged Wheels
body: The BC Forged KZ15 is a premium one-piece forged monoblock wheel designed for enthusiasts who want lightweight performance, precise fitment and a fully customized wheel setup for their vehicle. With its a 5-Y-spoke with the I-beam spokes in order to save extra weight and the deep race pockets , the KZ15 delivers a lightweight motorsport aesthetic focused on weight reduction, sharp detailing and brake visibility. It is a model that works especially well when a build needs more detail, better proportions and a stronger forged presence than a standard OEM wheel can offer. The design direction is especially relevant for owners who care about brake visibility, lower unsprung weight and a more technical enthusiast look. Each set is machined from a solid block of 6061-T6 aerospace-grade forged aluminum and built specifically for the exact vehicle application. Width, offset, bolt pattern, center bore, brake clearance and finish are tailored to the car, rather than forced into a generic fitment. Built Specifically For Your Car Every BC Forged KZ15 wheel set is manufactured to order. BaanVelgen verifies the complete specification before production, including offsets, brake clearance, load requirements and the desired stance of the car. This gives the KZ15 the flexibility to work as an OEM-plus replacement, a staggered performance setup, a square setup or a more aggressive custom specification. Depending on the application, different concavity profiles can be achieved while preserving safe fitment and proper brake clearance. Why Choose The BC Forged KZ15? The KZ15 stands out because of its a 5-Y-spoke with the I-beam spokes in order to save extra weight and the deep race pockets . That design language creates a clean, athletic stance with strong visual tension, while the forged monoblock construction keeps the wheel light, strong and suitable for real road use. Compared with a cast wheel, a forged monoblock wheel offers lower unsprung weight, better rigidity and a more precise custom-fit manufacturing process. The result is a wheel set that can improve steering response, suspension behavior and the overall premium feel of the car. Monoblock Forged Construction The BC Forged KZ15 uses a one-piece monoblock forged construction . Starting from a forged aluminum blank allows BC Forged to CNC-machine the final wheel shape with a high level of structural integrity and detail. This combination of strength, lower weight and vehicle-specific machining is one of the reasons forged wheels remain a preferred upgrade for sports cars, supercars, performance sedans and high-end SUVs. Design Character & Stance The full visual effect of the KZ15 comes from the combination of spoke shape, concavity, surface detailing and vehicle-specific fitment. For this model, the strongest direction is a sharper, more premium forged look that suits both street and performance builds . title: Eibach Pro Spacers for Audi RS6 C8
body: Eibach Wheel Spacers for Audi RS6 C8 . By increasing the track width of the Audi RS6 C8 you will achieve an optimized driving behavior combined with higher stability, as the roll of the chassis is influenced in a positive manner. And the wide arches of the RS6 just needs to be filled correctly, you only need the Eibach Pro-Spacer. It will fill the archers better, and give it that more agresive look, For the RS6 C8 we offer the Eibach spacers in 12mm, 15mm and 20mm to get the perfect stance. The Eibach spacers are the available in anodised silver or anodised black and come with the required bolts. Optional you can select the mcgard locking bolts. Both front and rear have a hub-centering collar to help support the wheel. The 12mm and 15mm are fastened by using longer wheel bolts, the 20mm is first fastened to the car with special bolts which are included and then the wheel is installed with the original bolts.

title: Brixton Forged JO01 Jon Olsson
body: Brixton Forged JO01 Jon Olsson wheels. The Brixton Forged JO01 wheel is multi-piece that incorporates the Brixton Forged PF7 wheel design. Brixton added several design components, 3D printed turbo-fans, vented aero rings, and custom milled motorsport CL caps with PCD covers. The results is an incredible wheel designed for Jon Olsson his “Leon the RS6”, the latest addition to his fleet, it is a 1000hp Audi RS6 tuned and built by Stertman Motorsport in Sweden. As Brixton began the Audi RS6 collaboration between Brixton Forged and C’est Normal / Jon Olsson, they went into it with the idea to build something truly unique that was different from the usual wheels that is created. This was a more modern take on the wheel that was recently created with Bisimoto and his electric Kremer K3 Porche 935 that stole the spotlight at Sema Show in 2019.

title: Brixton R11-R Duo Series
body: Brixton R11-R Duo Series wheels. The Brixton R11-R duo wheel is a detailed 10-spoke design with the R for race, making them extra light. The Brixton Forged 2-Piece Duo Series has a lightweight mono-center profile which is designed to increase dynamic cornering response, acceleration, and decrease overall stopping distance Each wheel set is tailored to be the most optimal combination of lightweight forging profiles and surface milling features. The duoblock wheels give the opportunity to make a wider wheel then the 1-piece wheels, and offer the deepest concave wheels in any width. Every Duoblock Series wheel set is individually designed and engineered specifically for each clients performance supercar, sedan or SUV. This ensures that every set has the best possible fitment, concavity and performance for your driving style. Each wheel set is built from scratch specifically for your vehicle and driving needs.

title: Brixton R11-R ULTRASPORT+

title: Vossen HF3
body: Vossen HF3 wheels - Hybrid Forged. The HF-3 sports the classic split 5 spoke design but with Vossens touch of design with unique beveling in each spoke and around the lug hole area. The Vossen HF-3 comes in two unique finishes with the popular Double Tinted Gloss Black and their luxurious Gloss Graphite Polished finish. The Vossen HF-3 wheels is available in three different concave profiles. Flat, Deep and Super Deep concave profiles allow for extremely aggressive fitments for a wide range of makes and models. Vossen HF3 wheels is a hybrid forged wheel, with this process the rim well of the cast blank is rolled out over a die with heat and pressure. The result is greater strength with a thinner wall and higher load capacities. This production technique makes it possible to reduce volume and weight in the rim well. Available in 19", 20", 21", 22" and 24 inch and 9 optional finishes. Gloss, satin or matte black, gloss gold, satin or gloss silver, satin or matte bronze or anthracite. Available Vossen Forged Finishes Vossen Forged wheels are available in a wide range of solid and transparent finishes, including gloss, satin, matte, textured, brushed and polished options. View the complete Vossen finish guide

title: Akrapovic Evolution exhaust system | Porsche 958.2 Cayenne Turbo
body: The Evolution system represents the top line of Akrapovič aftermarket exhaust systems for Porsche’s bestseller. The uniquely designed muffler from the Slip-On system with an added lightweight and exhaust flow–optimized link pipe set with bigger tubes fully represents the titanium Evolution exhaust system. This computer-designed system has been created to produce a deep, aggressive sound that transforms the Turbo into a racing machine. This is especially the case after removing the point-welded block in the link pipe that prevents bypassing the muffler. To control the sound level, Akrapovič offers an optional wireless kit. It’s up to you when you want to have a polite SUV cruiser or the sound of a racing machine. The Evolution system also works with the factory valve control system. The Akrapovič sound of the Cayenne Turbo’s engine is drone free and satisfies the ears with a muscly note that goes along with the unique muscle design of titanium or carbon fiber tail pipes. Both handcrafted sets are bigger in diameter than stock (105 mm). In addition to making the Cayenne more attractive, fitting an Akrapovič Evolution system on this SUV also has the advantage of keeping the weight down. The Evolution system, made from proprietary high-strength and lightweight titanium, delivers more power, improves responsiveness, and adds more torque. Altogether the system offers a complete package of unique image, deep aggressive sound, power gain, and weight loss. If the stock system does not have integrated exhaust valves then select the optional Akrapovic sound kit for adjustable sound. If the car is equipped with performance exhaust with electronic valve actuators than actuator set P-HF1006 is required and the Akrapovic sound kit P-HF1003 can not be used. If the car is not equipped with performance exhaust and you want to use the Akrapovic sound kit than Akrapovic sound kit P-HF1003 together with Actuator set P-HF1006 has to be ordered./p>

title: Eibach Pro Spacers for BMW G20 3-series

title: HRE P107SC
body: HRE P107SC is their latest 2019 wheel design. The design is a split-5-spoke design , and HRE took them to the next level by introducing additional aggressive design features. To create a more dynamic design language on the P107SC, particular attention was given to spoke intersection points and the outer lip surface. These areas further reduce mass but also increase visual interest to create the latest in HRE Forged wheel design. The HRE Series P1SC is the latest evolution of their best-selling Series P1. HRE started with the same philosophy of combining purposeful lightweight design with track-focused optimization. With purposeful I-Beam structures on all spoke sides and efficient lug bolt pockets, HRE was able to increase spoke stiffness while further reducing mass and thereby the unsprung weight of your car. The wheels are available in 19", 20", 21", 22" and 23 inch, they are custom build and therefor available for basicly every car. title: BC Forged RZ05 Monoblock Forged Wheels
body: The BC Forged RZ05 is a premium one-piece forged monoblock wheel designed for enthusiasts who want lightweight performance, precise fitment and a fully customized wheel setup for their vehicle. With its a 5-Y-spoke wheel with a deep concave design , the RZ05 delivers a sharp, race-inspired character with technical detailing and strong visual concavity. It is a model that works especially well when a build needs more detail, better proportions and a stronger forged presence than a standard OEM wheel can offer. This makes it an appealing choice for owners who want a forged upgrade that improves both the visual stance and the overall feel of the car. Each set is machined from a solid block of 6061-T6 aerospace-grade forged aluminum and built specifically for the exact vehicle application. Width, offset, bolt pattern, center bore, brake clearance and finish are tailored to the car, rather than forced into a generic fitment. Built Specifically For Your Car Every BC Forged RZ05 wheel set is manufactured to order. BaanVelgen verifies the complete specification before production, including offsets, brake clearance, load requirements and the desired stance of the car. This gives the RZ05 the flexibility to work as an OEM-plus replacement, a staggered performance setup, a square setup or a more aggressive custom specification. Depending on the application, different concavity profiles can be achieved while preserving safe fitment and proper brake clearance. Why Choose The BC Forged RZ05? The RZ05 stands out because of its a 5-Y-spoke wheel with a deep concave design . That design language creates a clean, athletic stance with strong visual tension, while the forged monoblock construction keeps the wheel light, strong and suitable for real road use. Compared with a cast wheel, a forged monoblock wheel offers lower unsprung weight, better rigidity and a more precise custom-fit manufacturing process. The result is a wheel set that can improve steering response, suspension behavior and the overall premium feel of the car. Monoblock Forged Construction The BC Forged RZ05 uses a one-piece monoblock forged construction . Starting from a forged aluminum blank allows BC Forged to CNC-machine the final wheel shape with a high level of structural integrity and detail. This combination of strength, lower weight and vehicle-specific machining is one of the reasons forged wheels remain a preferred upgrade for sports cars, supercars, performance sedans and high-end SUVs. Design Character & Stance The full visual effect of the RZ05 comes from the combination of spoke shape, concavity, surface detailing and vehicle-specific fitment. For this model, the strongest direction is a sharper, more premium forged look that suits both street and performance builds . Because every set is made to order, BaanVelgen can help specify the right width, offset and finish combination to suit ride height, tire choice, brake package and the overall look of the car. title: Akrapovic exhaust Porsche 991.2 Carrera / S / 4 / 4S / GTS
body: Akrapovic exhaust Porsche 991.2 Slip-on The Akrapovic exhaust for the Porsche 991.2 is built from high-grade, heat-resistant, ultra-lightweight titanium alloys, the Slip-On Line is the first step in exhaust modification. Delivering weight savings in excess of 35% over stock, while increasing performance, the exhaust uses the latest innovative technologies in its construction, including parts cast in Akrapovič’s in-house foundry. It is perfectly tuned to give a unique sound to the turbocharged boxer engine and is finished with two beautiful tailpipes to add to the aesthetic pleasure. Designed to replace the Porsche sport system, the Slip-On Line can also be used with the optional stainless-steel link pipe set to further improve sound and performance. Fitment notice: The system is designed to replace the both the Porsche sport exhaust system and the non-sport exhaust system. In order to replace the Porsche non sport standard exhaust system without valves, it has to be installed together with the Akrapovič Link Pipe Set with Cats, the Rear Carbon fiber diffuser and the Akrapovič Sound Kit. If your car is equipped with the Porsche non sport exhaust with valves, the sound kit is not required.

body: Model: 3 pieces wheel Design: 6 double-spokes design Hubcap: Black carbon fibre Finishing: Matt Graphit Silver, White, Matt Black, Chrystal Titanium, Orange, Race Gold, Red, Matt Race Silver or custom Dimensions: 18" - 19" - 20" Production process: Forged flange, Cast inner rim, HLT hand polished outer rim Materials: Flange: EN AW-6082, Inner rim: Al Si 7 Mg, Outer rim: Anticorodal EN AW-6082 About OZ Racing wheels Since creating its first wheels in 1971, O.Z. Racing has established itself as a leader in the world's light alloy wheel industry. O.Z. Racing produces standard equipment wheels for some of the most exclusive automobiles in the world including Ferrari, Lamborghini, Maserati, Aston Martin and Lotus. The Italian company also fills the needs of prestigious automotive equipment and bodywork companies like Bertone, Pininfarina, AMG, Hartge, Callaway, Schnitzer, Cizeta, Strosek and Giugiaro. A look inside the high technology design and manufacturing facilities of Ruote O.Z. Racing s.p.a. in Italy will unveil what it takes to create an O.Z. Racing wheel that is a winner on the highway and the race track. Each stage of production focuses on creating a stronger, more beautiful wheel and this commitment has earned them more titles in motorsports than any other brand, including Indy 500/IRL, LeMans Series and Formula 1 Grand Prix wins as well as World Rally Championships and more. O.Z. Racing never compromises on quality and complies with all official regulations of their client countries, including the stringent rules of T.U.V., the German control office. O.Z. Racing constantly submits their wheels to multiple comprehensive testing to measure road stress. And to detect minute flaws, wheels are put under pressure in a specially designed water tank and scanned for hidden flaws by X-ray. Further examination is done by computer and electron microscopes. Finally, an anti-corrosion treatment is given, followed by a protective lacquer coating and final cleaning. A Lap on the Nurburgring O.Z.'s pursuit of excellence is not limited to advanced manufacturing processes; every O.Z. wheel design is taken for simulated laps on the famous Nurburgring circuit. This is done with a biaxial test machine. The test simulation standard is guaranteed via a license released by the German research institute LBF Fraunhofer and is the most complete and the closest simulation of the harshest conditions wheels may experience. The machine simulates the radial forces, the axial forces, the accelerations, the decelerations and the road surface variations that the wheels would experience on the Nurburgring circuit for 22,000 miles. Even if not necessary for homologation purposes, O.Z. uses the experience acquired through the daily use of this machine to develop and further improve its wheels O.Z. title: Vorsteiner Nero Forged VFN 501 3-piece Step-Lip
body: The Vorsteiner Nero Forged VFN 501 3-piece Step-Lip. The Vorsteiner VFN501 Steplip wheels are made using the latest T-6061 aerospace grade aluminum blocks and individually machined to your exact standards. These 3-piece wheels are lightweight and load rated for your specific vehicle to maximize weight efficiency and performance. We also offer a virtually unlimited selection of custom finishes, only limited by your imagination. The 3-piece steplip consists of a three-piece construction, created with the deep concave profile forgings with a modified die designed to allow what is called a “contoured spoke” extension. This feature allows to engineer each set with spokes specifically following the exact contour of the step lip surface resulting in a look unlike any other wheel and performance to match. Back Pad Pocketing is applied to every wheel to shave off any weight that isn't required for structural integrity, keeping the weight of the wheels as low as possible. These wheels are compatible with the factory Tire Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS) of your vehicle and all designs are rigorously tested to exceed safety standards.

body: BBS LM Le Mans forged wheels are genuine two-piece forged aluminium wheels with the cross-spoke design derived from BBS racing wheels used at the 24 Hours of Le Mans. Introduced in 1994, the LM remains one of the most recognisable forged wheel designs worldwide. This product contains the complete current BBS LM range: 145 official specifications in 17, 18, 19, 20 and 21 inch diameters, combined with eight official finishes. The displayed price is for one individual wheel and already reflects the selected finish premium where applicable. Unsure which BBS LM fits your car? Send BaanVelgen the vehicle make, model, model year, exact version, brake specification and current tyre sizes. We can verify the correct front and rear LM type numbers before you order. Why choose the BBS LM? Genuine BBS two-piece forged aluminium construction Original Le Mans-inspired motorsport cross-spoke design Available in 17 to 21 inch diameters Official 4x100, 5x100, 5x108, 5x112, 5x114.3, 5x120 and 5x130 specifications Exact BBS type number, width, offset, bolt pattern, bore or PFS and wheel weight shown for every option Eight official BBS LM finish combinations Worldwide delivery and specialist fitment support from BaanVelgen How to order the correct BBS LM wheel Select the wheel diameter. Select the exact BBS LM type number and specification. Select the required finish. Select the quantity. A complete staggered set normally uses two front and two rear wheels with different LM type numbers. Diameter and bolt pattern alone do not confirm fitment. Offset, centre bore, brake clearance, vehicle load, tyre dimensions, suspension height and body clearance must also be checked. Some BBS LM specifications have vehicle-specific exclusions or require the original vehicle bolts or nuts. For pre-configured four-wheel packages, view the BBS forged wheel collection . For fitment assistance, contact BaanVelgen . body: The BBS Fi is the perfect balance where minimum mass meets maximum stability. A technological milestone, a sporty design and innovative material perfectly combined. This wheel is an inspiration for many other, but there is only one BBS FI. It is where minimal mass meets maximum stability. Forged from alloys used in the aerospace industries, stabilized by flow forming the inner rim well, and optimized by back-milling the spokes. A technological milestone that perfectly combines sporty design and innovative material. This FI wheel is the perfect upgrade for your sportcar to minimise unsprung weight.

title: Akrapovic full exhaust Porsche 992 GT3
body: Akrapovic full evolution exhaust Porsche 992 GT3 with OPF. The Evolution Header Set (E-PO/T/7) from Titanium for the Porsche 992 GT3 touring in combination with the Akrapovic Exhaust Slip-On Race Line (S-PO/TI/23), when you truly wish to experience the 4.0L six-cylinder engine. The Akrapovic muffler and headers are fully build from Titanium and of course the muffler is finished with 2 titanium eye-catching centered round tailpipes in titanium finish. Tuned quarter-length resonators with the catalytic converters ensure the sound quality and the absence of any distortion or unwanted frequencies, creating a unique sound experience for the Porsche. This provides an increases of 16.6 kW (22.6 hp) in power at 4,550 rpm and 35.2 Nm in torque at 4,500 rpm, when tested on the Akrapovic dyno against a Porsche 992 GT3 with a standard stock exhaust. When installing the Akrapovic Evolution Header Set on vehicles with particulate filters, remapping the ECU is mandatory to prevent potential check engine light warning signals. When installing the Akrapovic Evolution Header Set on vehicles without particulate filters, remapping the ECU is recommended but not required. You'll receive the Akrapovic Evolution Header Set (E-PO/T/7) and the Akrapovic Exhaust Slip-On Race Line with titanium tailpipes (S-PO/TI/23) This system will fit on the following Porsche models: 992.1 GT3 992.1 GT3 Touring 992.2 GT3 992.2 GT3 Touring

title: Akrapovic exhaust Porsche 992 GT3 Touring
body: Akrapovic Exhaust for Porsche 992 GT3 incl. Touring The Akrapovic Slip-On Race Line system in Titanium is the option when you wish to improve the sound of the Porsche 992 GT3. The Akrapovic muffler(S-PO/TI/23) is fully build from Titanium and the adapter set (P-CP034) is from Stainless steel. Of course the muffler is finished with 2 titanium eye-catching centered round tailpipes in titanium finish. The sound will be that unique sport Akrapovic sound from the 4.0L engine from the 992 GT3 and GT3 Touring. Sound and performance Most important is that this exhaust will not throw in any error or check engine codes, it is plug and play. With the Akrapovic Slip-On Race Line Adapter (SS), the weight is decreased by 20.7% (3.5 kg) against the standard system. Also the performance sees an increase of 6.5 kW (8.8 hp) in power at 2,900 rpm and a torque rise of 24.1 Nm at 2,400 rpm. title: Manthey Racing Braided Brake Line Kit for Porsche 991, 992 & 718 GT Models
body: The Manthey Racing Braided Brake Line Kit is a focused braking upgrade for Porsche GT models, designed to create a firmer brake pedal, sharper brake response and more consistent pedal feedback under demanding driving conditions. Available for selected Porsche 991 GT3, 991 GT3 RS, 991 GT2 RS, 992 GT3, 992 GT3 RS, 992 GT3 Touring, 718 GT4 and 718 GT4 RS models, this Manthey Racing brake line kit replaces the factory rubber brake hoses with stainless steel braided brake lines. The stainless steel braided construction helps reduce brake line expansion under hydraulic pressure. This gives the driver a more direct connection to the braking system, especially during repeated heavy braking, fast road driving, track days or Nürburgring-focused use. Why Upgrade to Manthey Racing Braided Brake Lines? On a Porsche GT car, braking feel is just as important as braking power. Standard rubber brake hoses can expand slightly when the brake system is under pressure. This can make the brake pedal feel softer or less precise, especially when the car is driven hard. The Manthey Racing braided brake line kit helps limit this expansion. The result is a firmer, more responsive and more confidence-inspiring brake pedal. It is a subtle upgrade, but one that makes a noticeable difference for drivers who value precision and control. This makes the kit especially relevant for Porsche GT owners who use their car on mountain roads, fast road routes, track days or as part of a complete Manthey-style performance setup. title: AKRAPOVIČ SLIP-ON LINE BMW M3 G80/G81 & M4 G82/G83
body: The Akrapovič Slip-On Line (Titanium) for the BMW M3 G80/G81 and BMW M4 G82/G83 is a lightweight, valve-controlled titanium exhaust system developed to improve the sound, performance and appearance of the G8X M3 and M4. It is compatible with both pre-LCI and BMW M3 and M4 LCI models , including the M3 Touring G81, M4 Convertible G83 and xDrive versions. Made from high-grade titanium, the Akrapovič Slip-On Line replaces the standard rear exhaust section and reduces weight by 8.3 kg, or 35% compared with the factory system . The result is a deeper and more distinctive exhaust note while retaining refinement during normal driving. Akrapovič exhaust for BMW M3 G80/G81 and M4 G82/G83 The G8X-generation BMW M3 and M4 combine the S58 twin-turbo six-cylinder engine with exceptional performance, but the standard exhaust leaves room for a more engaging sound. Akrapovič developed the Slip-On Line to add a richer tone without introducing unwanted drone. At lower engine speeds and during cruising, the system remains refined. Under acceleration and at higher rpm, the exhaust develops a deeper and more pronounced character that better matches the performance of the M3 and M4. A specially developed Akrapovič control kit is included with the system and manages the exhaust valves for the intended Akrapovič sound experience. Performance and weight reduction Akrapovič tested the Slip-On Line against the standard exhaust on a BMW M4 Competition. The titanium system produced measurable improvements in both power and torque while substantially reducing exhaust weight. Power gain +8.0 kW / +10.9 hp at 6,000 rpm Torque gain +13.9 Nm at 5,000 rpm Weight reduction -8.3 kg Weight saving 35% compared with the standard exhaust Material High-grade titanium Part number S-BM/TI/33H ECE approved for BMW M3 and M4 LCI The Akrapovič Slip-On Line is ECE type approved for BMW M3 and M4 models equipped with an OPF/GPF gasoline particulate filter . This includes compatible LCI models, making the system an attractive road-legal upgrade for European G8X owners who want more sound without replacing the complete exhaust system. The exhaust itself also fits compatible non-OPF vehicles, but the ECE type approval is only valid when installed on vehicles equipped with OPF/GPF. title: Akrapovič Evolution Link Pipe Titanium BMW M3 G80/G81 & M4 G82/G83
body: The Akrapovič Evolution Link Pipe Set (Titanium) – Long transforms the Akrapovič Slip-On Line for the BMW M3 and BMW M4 into the complete Evolution exhaust system. Designed specifically for the BMW S58 twin-turbo inline-six engine, this titanium centre section improves exhaust flow, reduces weight and unlocks a deeper, richer and more powerful exhaust note. It is the ideal upgrade for drivers who already have the Akrapovič Slip-On Line and want a more pronounced sound and the full performance potential of the Akrapovič exhaust system. High-grade titanium construction The complete link pipe set is manufactured from high-grade titanium. Compared with the original BMW centre exhaust section, the Akrapovič system is 8.4 kg lighter , representing a weight reduction of approximately 62.7% . A specially developed resonator is integrated into the centre section. This creates a deep and sporty exhaust character while helping to prevent unwanted resonance and drone inside the cabin. Under acceleration, the Evolution system delivers a significantly more intense version of the characteristic BMW S58 straight-six sound, without making the car unnecessarily uncomfortable during normal driving. Akrapovič-tested performance When combined with the Akrapovič Slip-On Line, Akrapovič recorded the following performance gains on its dyno: Power increase: +17.7 kW / +24.1 hp at 6,650 rpm Torque increase: +25.4 Nm at 6,650 rpm Weight reduction: 8.4 kg / 62.7% compared with the stock centre section These results were measured on a BMW M4 Competition with OPF/GPF, comparing the complete Akrapovič exhaust configuration with the standard factory exhaust system. Deeper sound without unwanted drone The Akrapovič Evolution Link Pipe produces a deeper, fuller and more aggressive exhaust note than the Slip-On Line alone. The sound becomes increasingly intense as engine speed rises, bringing out the pure character of the turbocharged BMW six-cylinder engine. The integrated central resonator keeps the sound controlled and refined at constant speeds, while allowing the exhaust to become considerably more vocal during acceleration. The difference between the open and closed exhaust valve positions remains clearly noticeable, allowing the character of the exhaust to be adjusted depending on the driving situation. title: Eventuri Carbon Intake System for Audi RS6 / RS7 C8 4.0 TFSI
body: Eventuri Carbon Intake System for Audi RS6 / RS7 C8 The Eventuri Carbon Intake System for the Audi RS6 C8 and Audi RS7 C8 is one of the most complete intake upgrades available for the 4.0 TFSI twin-turbo V8 platform. Designed to replace the restrictive factory airbox, this system combines a high-volume carbon fibre airbox, enlarged turbo inlets and a bespoke BMC panel filter to create a smoother, more efficient airflow path to the turbos. Where a simple open filter often adds sound but compromises heat management, the Eventuri system is engineered as a complete sealed intake solution. The redesigned airbox uses the available space inside the RS6 and RS7 engine bay more efficiently, while the larger turbo inlet openings reduce restriction and help the turbos reach target boost more effectively. Why upgrade to the Eventuri intake? Designed specifically for the Audi RS6 C8 and RS7 C8 Available in gloss carbon or matte carbon Enlarged turbo inlets for improved airflow Custom BMC panel filter for high flow and proper filtration Improved throttle response and turbo efficiency OEM+ fitment with a high-end carbon fibre finish Suitable for stock, Stage 1 and Stage 2 setups Performance gains According to Eventuri test data, the C8 RS6 / RS7 intake system delivers measurable performance gains across different tuning stages: Stock ECU: 15–25 hp / 11–20 ft-lbs Stage 1: 45–50 hp / 40–45 ft-lbs Stage 1 100–200 km/h: reduced by 0.6 seconds Stage 2: 60–80 hp / 60–70 ft-lbs The biggest benefit becomes especially clear on tuned cars, where the turbos require more air than the factory airbox can efficiently supply. Eventuri also reports a flow increase of up to 90% for the complete system compared to the OEM intake setup. Engineering details The Eventuri intake is not simply a cosmetic carbon cover. The complete system has been redesigned from the airbox base to the lid and turbo inlets. The carbon airbox increases internal volume, the filter angle is improved, and the airflow path is shaped to reduce turbulence before the air reaches the turbos. The turbo inlets are enlarged by up to 85% at the airbox side, helping reduce pressure drop and allowing the turbos to operate more efficiently. Combined with smooth transitions and a bespoke BMC filter element, the system is built for both performance and consistent airflow quality. What is included? title: Wheel Stud 14x1.25 90mm - black
body: Stud & Lug nut conversion kits BMW For non race cars, stud conversions make wheel install and removal much easier as you do not have to line up the holes in your wheels, spacers, and hubs before hand threading in a single lug bolt. Simply slide the wheel onto the studs, and let go. Your wheel will no longer spin around the hub, but will instead be lined up correctly. Extended length studs like these allow for a range of spacers to be used without any additional modification. You can easily use 3, 5, 10, 12mm or no spacer at all. When using lug bolts with spacers you are forced to purchase a different length lug for each width spacer. Why own a bucket full of lugs when a single set of studs can do it all? By remaining installed, the studs put less ware on the threads of your hubs. They guarantee there is enough thread engagement, as you can see how many threads were engaged during install. Wheel studs replace your OEM lug bolts by simply threading into your cars hub. Once installed they do not need to be removed when changing or removing wheels. Only the lug bolts are removed similar to many domestic vehicles. Features: APEX Wheel studs are 10.9 grade steel, and produced in Europe by a TUV approved OEM supplier 75mm length allows for the use of spacers up to 12mm in thickness, or no spacer at all, without making any changes The studs have a bulletnose tip that makes lug nut install and removal easy, and prevents cross threading The head has an integrated 5.5mm hex to make initial installation a breeze The hardened studs are black zinc plated, while the nuts are available in both black and silver zinc plating Studs and nuts are 12x1.5 or 14x 1.25 thread depending on your vehicle with a 60 degree taper identical to OEM BMW hardware.

body: Eventuri Carbon intake Mini JCW GP3 The Mini GP3 JCW Eventuri intake system is fully made out of carbon. The intake features the Eventuri 2nd generation dry filter which will help to shape the airflow, maintain the laminar conditions, and gives the smoothest possible airflow directly to the turbo inlet tube. It is a sealed system which ensures that the turbo does not draw hot air from the engine bay but enhanced with a functional bonnet scoop which forces ambient air into the intake duct. The duct has a larger internal volume than the stock version and also draws air from the stock location above the radiator. The combination of a sealed system with an air scoop results in lower intake temperatures than the stock airbox and avoids heat soak which is a common issue especially on higher powered MINIs. To ensure the smoothest flow possible Eventuri uses their Patented Venturi filter housing which has an integrated MAF section for a seamless flow path to the turbo. Fitment for the following models: Mini 306hp F56 JCW GP3 and 306hp F54 JCW Clubman

The B48 intake features the Eventuri 2nd generation dry filter which will help to shape the airflow and maintain the laminar conditions. The housing seals to the front duct which are maximised in volume to reduce any potential restrictions in flow, while the duct ensures that only ambient air is provided to the filter. This results that the IATs are steady for most driving conditions. The system allows for better throttle response and allows for the turbo to work with a lower waste-gate duty cycle.

title: Akrapovic exhaust Audi RSQ8 4M
body: Akrapovic exhaust for Audi RSQ8 4M. Akrapovic evolutution exhaust for the Audi RSSQ8 is constructed entirely from low-weight, high-grade titanium, it features a central muffler flanked by two valves and a link pipe set with a X-connection element. With a unique sound patterns designed to offer maximum enjoyment, the X-connection in the link pipe section gives the exhaust system its characteristic of the Akrapovič high-frequency racing tone in the upper rev range, which is complemented by the deep and iconic rumbleof the Audi RSQ8 from low down in the rev range, providing a distinctive V8 growl. With the valves closed there is enough comfort, with no unwanted noise or drone in the cabin. Finished with eye-catching carbon-fibre / titanium tailpipes on either side of the rear of the car, the exhaust also increases power by 7 kW (9.4 hp) at 5,600 rpm and adds 17.2 Nm of torque at 2,500 rpm when tested on Akrapovič’s in-house dyno in back-to-back runs with RS Q8 against the stock RS Sport exhaust system. It is a plug-and-play product, and due to its ECE type approval there is no need to tune the ECU.

body: Akrapovic Downpipe for the Audi RSQ8 4M . The Akrapovic downpipe for the Audi RSQ8 4m, this optional linkpipe is an upgrade to the Evolution Line (Titanium) exhaust for further stage 2 tuning. The downpipes contain 200 cpsi catalytic converters, insulated to prevent overheating any parts around them. The RSQ8 stainless-steel link pipes have custom-made flex tubes, with insulation where they connect to the downpipes. When fitted with the Akrapovic Evolution Line, the Audi will get its true performance and sound. It is perfectly tuned by the sound engineers to produce a pure V8 aural performance and high-frequency racing tone in the upper rev range and a deep and torquey V8 rumble in lower revs, with the comfort mode retained for those more sedate moments with the valves closed. For OPF remapping the ECU is mandatory.

body: The Eventuri Carbon Chargepipes BMW F8x M3 / M4 S55 engine. The BMW BMW f80 M3 and F82 M4 Carbon Fiber S55 Chargepipes from Eventuri. Eventuri invested months of intense R&D in development and testing to bring an OEM replacement chargepipes which leave no room for compromise. FITMENT- FLOW QUALITY – STRENGTH are the 3 main design criteria which Eventuri sought to meet. The fitment of the Eventuri Carbon Chargepipes BMW F8x M3 / M4 is like OEM BMW. B y using carbon fiber allows to use complex geometry. With the smooth curve transitions from the turbo outlets to the charge-cooler and increased the internal volume as compared to the OEM version to allow the turbos to work with less restriction. And finally the strength, It is becoming increasingly common for the OEM chargepipes to fail especially with tuned cars running higher boost levels. Eventuri is using a cross-directional carbon weave layup with multiple layers to form a 2mm wall thickness, the Eventuri chargepipes provide an incredibly strong solution for reliable operation even with larger turbos. Furthermore they have embedded CNC machined stainless steel rings into the openings where the clamps are tightened to ensure the pipes maintain their shape even under high clamping forces. The wheel’s typical racing design has been made even more aggressive by the new concave profiles, designed specifically for cars whose brake caliper size allows for extreme offsets.

title: Eventuri Carbon intake | BMW X3M / X4M
body: BMW X3M / X4M Eventuri intake system. The BMW X3M F97 and X4M F98 intake setup from BMW is different then we see in other models, but it is a very well designed system in the given space available. The flow path from the filters to the turbo inlets is very direct and does not change direction as abruptly as the usual OEM airbox designs. So instead of a complete redesign Eventuri focused on improving the OEM airbox with less restrictive flow and improved temperature efficiency. They have developed a replacement drop in filters made from non-woven mesh which have a much higher flow rate as compared to the stock paper filters. To help reduce inlet air temperatures and force air into the airbox Eventuri designed large front scoops which sit behind the grills. The carbon scoops channel air into the ducts and effectively effectively de-restrict the inlet side of the airbox. The final piece is the carbon airbox lid which although doesn’t add to the performance, it does allow for a more audible induction sound and gives the engine bay a much needed aesthetic improvement. Fitment for the following models: BMW F97 X3m and BMW F98 X4M, incl. performance models.

title: KW HAS Height adjustable spring kit AUDI RS6 C7
body: KW HAS for Audi RS6 C7, Height adjustable spring kit. The KW HAS kit is used for lowering the vehicle in combination with the serial dampers and DRC, even when electronic damper control is installed. This lowering solution from KW Suspension optimises the dynamic performance and the steering behaviour without the electronic damper control deactivated. For this solution vehicle specific adjustable spring seats with adjusted KW lowering springs and the matching elastomer as well as the dust cover system will be used. With conventional lowering springs you have to decide on the lowering from the beginning, but not with the KW height adjustable spring kits. Depending on the vehicle specific application you can change the lowering within the adjustment range with the threaded spring perch when the springs are already installed. In this case for the Audi RS6 the KW height adjustable spring kit lowers the car in the range of 5-30mm in front and 15-40mm for the rear. You will not have any difficulties to adjust the lowering when changing your wheel/tire combination. Adjustable lowering solution, Individual height adjustability of the serial suspension kit Serial suspension system also with electronic damper control stays active Improved optic and vehicle dynamics Optimal performance Better steering behaviour

body: The Eventuri Sealed Carbon Duct for the BMW F8x M3/M4 The Eventuri Sealed Carbon Duct upgrades your V1 Eventuri intake to the V2 system. After months of data logging and design iterations Eventuri updated their S55 M3/M4 intake system with a Sealed Duct and Shield. This new addition to their intake isolates the intake path from the engine bay and avoids heat soak when at low speeds or stationary. The sealed carbon duct closes the front of the filter housing and stops heat from entering the filter area while still allowing some air entry from the cold side of the engine bay where the hood meets the wing, which ensures that it doesn't cause a restriction. In addition, the heat shield completely blocks out the hot air being pushed into the engine bay from the radiator. The new sealed duct design works perfectly with our Patented carbon Venturi housing, carbon inlet tube and the carbon air scoop.

title: BAAN Air Suspension Lowering Links for Audi RS Q8
body: BAAN Air Suspension Lowering Links for Audi RS Q8 are developed by BaanVelgen for the Audi RS Q8 equipped with factory adaptive air suspension. Create a balanced front-to-rear stance on the Audi RS Q8 with BAAN adjustable sensor links. The system is designed around the factory suspension layout and can be fine-tuned after installation. Key benefits for the RS Q8 Complete vehicle-specific solution: The price includes a complete vehicle-specific lowering-link set for the front and rear axles. Adjustable while installed: opposing left-hand and right-hand threads allow fine adjustment by rotating the central adjuster while the links remain connected to the vehicle. Corrosion-resistant construction: precision-machined aluminium adjusters are combined with stainless-steel link ends and ball-joint sockets for exposed underbody use. Secure mechanical retention: locking nuts secure the selected length and dual metal safety-retaining clips help keep the sockets connected to the factory sensor balls. No coding or electronic module: the links mechanically change the ride-height sensor reference without adding a controller to the vehicle wiring. Reversible installation: the original sensor links can be reinstalled to return the vehicle to its original configuration. RS Q8 lowering range Front axle 0 to approximately 50 mm lower Rear axle 0 to approximately 50 mm lower Front and rear settings can be fine-tuned independently where applicable. The final measured ride height depends on the original vehicle calibration, suspension mode, vehicle load, tyre pressure and wheel-and-tyre configuration. Substantial lowering should be assessed for tyre clearance, suspension travel and road suitability. Technical specifications Brand BAAN Lowering Links Developed by BaanVelgen Development location Rotterdam, the Netherlands Production Precision-manufactured in Taiwan to BaanVelgen specifications Vehicle Audi RS Q8 Suspension compatibility factory adaptive air suspension Central adjuster Precision-machined aluminium with anti-slip knurling Link ends and sockets Corrosion-resistant stainless steel Adjustment mechanism Opposing left-hand and right-hand threads; adjustable on the car Retention system Mechanical locking nuts and dual metal safety-retaining clips Dimensional inspection Critical dimensions inspected using measuring equipment with a resolution of 0.001 mm Coding required No Installation Reversible, vehicle-specific replacement of the factory sensor links How BAAN Lowering Links work The factory ride-height sensors measure suspension position through short mechanical links. Replacing the fixed original links with adjustable BAAN links changes the mechanical reference supplied to the suspension controller. The vehicle then maintains a lower static position without software coding or an electronic signal-interception module. body: Mercedes W205 C63S AMG Eventuri intake system is the culmination of extensive development and testing. The design brief consisted of 3 main objectives: 1) Increased flow rate. 2) Low intake temperatures. 3) Smooth airflow. The first objective was met by utilising all of the limited space available in the C63S engine bay resulting in a 35% higher flow rate over the stock system. The second objective was met by designing a fully sealed system. The C63S engine bay reaches high temperatures with heat sources like the turbos in close proximity to the intake so it is crucial that the intake remains sealed. The final objective was met by designing an organically shaped system with custom rounded panel filters to ensure the airflow path contained no sharp corners and therefore allowed for the flow to remain laminar. With smooth transitions from the filters to the turbo inlets, the intake minimises the formation of turbulence and therefore the turbos are able to operate more efficiently. With all 3 objectives met, the Eventuri W205 C63S intake system delivers on all fronts and allows for the turbos to generate boost more efficiently. This results in an improved throttle response and genuine power gains which increase with higher states of tune. Since there are various turbo upgrades available for the C63S there is also a specific solution for larger turbos. The C63S intake is available in 2 configurations: 61mm ID outlets to match the stock and hybrid turbos and 3″ ID outlets to match larger aftermarket turbos. Fitment for the following models: Mercedes W205 S205 C205 A205 C63 C63S AMG, GLC63S and GLC63 AMG

title: Novitec spacers for Ferrari 458 10mm

title: Eventuri Carbon Plenum | BMW E92 M3
body: The Eventuri BMW E92 M3 Carbon Fiber Plenum . Made from 100% high-grade prepreg carbon including the internal trumpets, this plenum replaces the stock plastic version and unleashes the roar of the naturally aspirated BMW V8 engine. Since the trumpet lengths are tuned by BMW to the internal volume, changing this could result in a loss of performance so we kept the same volume to not upset the way the car drives in terms of power delivery. Although there isn't a performance gain from the carbon plenum, the induction sound generated takes the driving experience of the M3 to a whole new level. The raw V8 rumble gives the E92 M3 an almost CSL like sound and is truly an intoxicating experience. Eventuri went through several iterations using different carbon thicknesses to fine tune the sound and the resulting plenum generates an almost unbelievable induction volume and tone. This plenum can be used with the OEM airbox or any aftermarket intake system including ofcourse the Eventuri intake systems which do provide a genuine performance increase.

title: Akrapovic Evolution exhaust system | Renault Mégane Coupé RS
body: Renault Mégane Coupé RS 2016 | Akrapovic evolution exhaust The Akrapovič Evolution Line performance exhaust system takes the performance of the Renault Mégane RS to even greater heights. The lower weight of the system over stock improves the car’s handling, and together with the increase in power and torque makes this impressive hot hatch an even more thrilling experience. Beautifully crafted from titanium and finished with a unique carbon fibre tailpipe, the Evolution Line system will make the Mégane RS stand out from the crowd. When the high-revving engine lets out that distinctive deep and sporty Akrapovič sound, the whole package becomes one for all the senses to enjoy. Note: this product does not meet emission compliance requirements for street or highway use.

title: Akrapovic Evolution exhaust system | Renault Clio III RS 200
body: Renault Clio III RS 200 | Akrapovic evolution exhaust The Clio R.S. is known as a real “hot hatch” among small cars. Akrapovič offers a Slip-On exhaust system in stainless steel with a two-muffler design and exquisitely designed and manufactured tailpipes. The Slip-On gives the Clio R.S. additional power and torque, and reduces the weight. The system also improves the driving characteristics at practically all rpms and gives the 2-liter engine that distinctive Akrapovič sound. The performance is taken even further with the added stainless steel link pipe with an integrated resonator. The impact on weight loss and performance versus the stock system of the Renault Clio RS is even more dramatic. There are real power delivery gains, and the engine, which is already primed for high-rev action, spins even more effectively, which in practical terms means that it’s noticeably more responsive. The sound is deeper, sportier, and louder, akin to racing in the Clio Cup, but without droning. The look of Clio R.S. with the Evolution system is completed with distinctive precision-crafted carbon fibre tailpipes.

title: Akrapovic Evolution exhaust system | Porsche 970.2 Panamera Turbo / Turbo S
body: We made no compromises when developing the new Evolution exhaust system for this four-door sporty limousine. This new aftermarket system is noticeably louder, with a deep and very aggressive sound, to fully express the racing-oriented nature of this exhaust, which is made from our proprietary titanium alloy. This complete beautifully crafted titanium system consists of four round tail pipes, computer-optimized asymmetrical mufflers with a “dual mode” exhaust valve system, and a link pipe with a resonator to eliminate any chance of in-cabin droning. When using the Akrapovič installation kit, the exhaust valves of the “dual mode” system can be fixed in open or closed position. To experience the full potential of the Evolution exhaust system, we developed an optional wireless control kit. With a simple press of a button, the driver can close or open the flaps to choose between a loud racy sound or a quieter note for long-distance driving. When the valves are open the gas flow bypasses the mufflers. Performance This Evolution system not only transforms the Panamera’s nature with a racing look and especially its sound, but also adds more power and torque, improves power distribution, and also helps reduce weight. The Evolution system is perfect and has a leak-free fit. The package contains: - Titanium link pipe with resonator - titanium mufflers with integrated exhaust flaps - titanium tailpipes, - fitting material

title: Akrapovic Evolution exhaust system // BMW E70 X5M
body: A twin turbo, 4.4 liter, 555 horsepower SUV? Only from the M division of BMW could a beast such as this be set loose on the world. Akrapovič is proud to have designed an exhaust system that unleashes the typical V8 roar from the engine of this technically advanced and premium BMW. Performance We have constructed a complete “catalyst back” exhaust system manufactured entirely from our proprietary titanium alloy, which introduces enhancements to the exhaust design not found in the stock system. One of the most important changes is the incorporation of an X-pipe in the system. The inclusion of an X-pipe increases low to mid-range power while at the same time producing a deeper exhaust note that the original system lacks. Additionally, a pair of resonators are added to eliminate any chance of in-cabin droning. The mounting flanges are made of cast titanium from our in-house foundry and ensure a perfect, leak-free fit. Moving to the muffler section of our system, we have retained the “dualmode” exhaust flap control from the original system. This allows the vehicle to have a more civilized, but deeper than stock sound at low speed. However, at higher RPM (or when selecting the “S” mode on the gearshift) the muffler is bypassed, creating a deep and sporty sound much more in keeping with the personality of the car. Two exhaust tail pipe options are available; both are 100 mm in diameter. The first is made completely from titanium while the other is crafted from a carbon fiber/titanium composite. The carbon fiber version was developed on the BMW X6 M MotoGP Safety Car, which is driven at sustained high speed, to guarantee uncompromised durability. Performance has not been left out of the design. The system dramatically reduces backpressure and is an excellent starting point for further engine tuning or turbo modifications. Even when installed on an otherwise stock vehicle a gain of 11 horsepower and 15 Nm / 11 lbs-ft of torque are achieved. Furthermore, a weight reduction of 23 kg / 50 lbs. is realized. The OEM catalysts are retained, so no reflashing of the ECU is required and the check engine light will not be triggered. Hard facts: Plus 11 HP (at 6,200 rpm) Plus 15 Nm / 11 lbs-ft of torque (at 2,270 rpm) 23 kg / 50 lbs. lighter than stock The package contains: - Titanium resonators, - titanium mufflers, - exhaust valves - carbon or titanium tailpipes - fitting material

title: Eventuri Intake | Porsche 991 Turbo
body: The porsche 991 Turbo Eventuri intake carbon system is developed through extensive real world testing with the aim of allowing the turbos to work more efficiently. The single stock airbox is replaced by the dual individual patented eventuri filter housings, the turbos are able to spool and generate boost with less drag. As a result, the wastegate duty cycles are reduced resulting in peak boost at lower RPM and therefore performance is increased. The two individual filters provide a larger filtration area as compared to the single stock panel filter. Furthermore, in order to keep inlet air temperatures down, the eventuri housings are sealed against an air duct which draws ambient air from the same location as the stock system. Since the 911 Turbo engine bay is densely packed, high IATs can only be avoided by ensuring a fully sealed intake system. The combination of a smoother airflow path to each turbo with low IATs results in higher performance and a sharper throttle response over the stock airbox. Available for Porsche Turbo 991.1 and 991.2, also for Turbo S, The acceleration Time : 60-130mph Reduced By 0.2 seconds The system consists of, and you will receive: 2 x Carbon Fiber Venturi Housings with Integrated Tubes 2 x Bespoke High Flow Generation 2 Filters 2 x Aluminium Inlet Cowls Carbon Fiber inlet duct Laser Cut Stainless Steel bracket work

title: Eventuri Carbon Intake | Volkswagen Golf R Mk7 | kevlar
body: The Volkswagen Golf R Mk7 carbon intake system from Eventuri has been developed to provide the most efficient and direct airflow path to the turbo. By replacing the OEM intake with their Patent Pending Venturi housing and coupling this with a smooth duct, they have ensured that the airflow remains as laminar as possible. Furthermore, the addition of a true cold air feed by adding a scoop to the front grill results in the lowest possible inlet air temperature. The result is an optimised intake system which delivers noticeable performance gains consistently. The VAG 2.0 TFSi system uses our Patent Pending Carbon fibre Housing which provides an aerodynamically efficient airflow path from the filter to the turbo tube. Not just another cone filter with a heat shield but a unique design which allows airflow to remain laminar and thus improve the turbo efficiency. This intake system is available in black carbon fibre as well as a range of Kevlar options in Red, Blue, Yellow or Orange. Performance Gain: 16-25hp, 15-22ft-lb

title: Eventuri Carbon Intake | BMW M2 competition F87n
body: The BMW M2 Competition F87n Eventuri carbon intake system. The Eventuri intake is designed to allow the turbos to work more efficiently from the BMW M2 competition. By replacing the stock airbox system with the Patented eVenturi filter housings and smoothly curved carbon tubes, the airflow to the turbos is more laminar and therefor the turbos can spool with less drag and much quicker. Since the M2 Competition does not have air openings behind the grills like the BMW M4 does, they have added sealed ducts to ensure that the intake temperatures stay as low as possible. The combination of the eVenturi housings, organically shaped tubes and sealed ducts result in an optimised intake which sets a benchmark for this BMW M2 competition. The M2 Competition Eventuri system uses the Patented Carbon Fibre Housings with the Gen 2 filters, which provide an aerodynamically efficient airflow path from the filter to the turbos. Not just another cone filter with a heat shield but a unique design which invokes the Venturi effect and maintains laminar flow conditions to reduce the drag on the turbo. The system consists of, and you will receive: 2 x Patented Carbon Fiber eVenturi housings 2 x Bespoke High Flow Generation 2 Filters 2 x Aluminium Cowls for smooth airflow entry Left Side Carbon Tube with integrated MAF sensor mount Right Side Carbon Tube with integrated MAF sensor mount 2 Carbon Fiber Intake Ducts Laser Cut Stainless Steel Brackets High quality Silicon couplers with BMW specification hose clamps

body: The Eventuri Sealed Carbon Duct for the BMW F87 M2 carbon intake system upgrades your V1 Eventuri intake to the V2 system. After months of data logging and design iterations Eventuri updated their N55/F87 M2 intake system with a Sealed Duct and Shield. This new addition to their intake isolates the intake path from the engine bay and avoids heat soak when at low speeds or stationary. The sealed carbon duct closes the front of the filter housing and stops heat from entering the filter area while still allowing some air entry from the cold side of the engine bay where the hood meets the wing, which ensures that it doesn't cause a restriction. In addition, the heat shield completely blocks out the hot air being pushed into the engine bay from the radiator. The new sealed duct design works perfectly with our Patented carbon Venturi housing, carbon inlet tube and the carbon air scoop.

title: Eventuri Carbon Intake | Audi RS4 RS5 B9
body: Audi RS4/RS5 B9 Eventuri intake The Eventuri intake with secondary duct is developed to give less restrictive airflow to the turbo whilst maintaining low inlet temperatures. The RS5/RS4 B9 engine bay becomes heat soaked very quickly so simply having an open cone system would result in better airflow but with higher inlet temperatures. Eventuri therefore completely re-engineered the inlet track from the turbo inlet pipe to the front grill with a highly efficient sealed system. The restrictive stock airbox and flexible plastic inlet pipe have been replaced with a Venturi filter housing and a duct system with smooth transitions. Furthermore, by removing the convoluted stock inlet pipe and replacing it with our one-piece Venturi housing and solid tube, the airflow is much smoother as it enters the turbo inlet tube. The resulting performance gains and aesthetics are industry leading for this platform. This intake system is available in black carbon fibre, Performance Gain: 11-16hp, 12-17ft-lb At The Wheels.

title: Eventuri Carbon Intake | Audi S1
body: The AUDI S1 carbon intake system from Eventuri has been developed to provide the most efficient and direct airflow path to the turbo. By replacing the OEM intake with their Patent Pending Venturi housing and coupling this with a smooth duct, they have ensured that the airflow remains as laminar as possible. The Audi S1 system uses the Eventuri Patented Carbon fibre Housing which provides an aerodynamically efficient airflow path from the filter to the turbo tube. Not just another cone filter with a heat shield but a unique design which allows airflow to remain laminar and thus improve the turbo efficiency. The standard airbox is cuboid in shape which gives rise to turbulence and increases the drag on the turbo as a result. The transition from the rectangular air filter to the round turbo inlet gives rise to inefficiencies in the flow path which are addressed with our Venturi housing system. title: Eisenmann Exhaust | BMW M2 competition F87N
body: The Eisenmann Exhaust for the BMW M2 Competition with the S55 engine. After the long awaited release of the BMW M2 F87N the sound optimization is now being carried out by specialists from Eisenmann Exhaust System GmbH. The sound of the 3.0-liter Biturbo is again significantly bassiger and sonorous by the Eisenmann exhaust system in all load conditions. Each system is constructed from high grade 304 stainless steel, with a specific attention to wall thickness throughout to create the best combination of fantastic sound and reduced weight. The canisters are machine-pressed into a shape specifically designed for the F8x M cars using a series of deep draw dies, resulting in extremely high canister rigidity and contributing to Eisenmann’s signature tone. The canister shape was specifically created to completely eliminate the canisters from the rear view of the car, drastically improving the appearance of the M2 Competition. Multiple internal flow paths work in unison with BMW’s Comfort, Sport, and Sport Plus ECU programming, and enable Eisenmann’s valve control to have a variable but drastic effect on the exhaust system’s personality, yielding a quiet tone while cruising and a fearsome growl under full load.

title: Eventuri Carbon Intake V2 BMW F90 M5
body: The Eventuri Carbon Intake V2 BMW F90 M5 was developed through extensive real world testing and airflow simulation analysis. It demonstrates the perfect balance between allowing for unrestricted airflow with the semi-open filter housings whilst maintaining low IATs through cold air saturation with the Eventuri scoop and shield combination. Introducing the updated V2 F90 M5 intake system. After the successful launch of our original F90 M5 intake, we have continued to test them on the road and at various track events. Having gathered more data, we decided to seal the openings of the filter housings with carbon shrouds. These shrouds close off the visible filter openings in the engine bay while still allowing for the cold air saturation from the front scoops. The Eventuri Carbon Intake V2 BMW F90 M5 uses the Patented Carbon Fibre Housings with the Gen 2 filters, which provide an aerodynamically efficient airflow path from the filter to the turbos. Not just another cone filter with a heat shield but a unique design which invokes the Venturi affect and maintains laminar flow conditions to reduce the drag on the turbo.

title: BAAN Air Suspension Lowering Links for Tesla Model X
body: BAAN Air Suspension Lowering Links for Tesla Model X are developed by BaanVelgen for the Tesla Model X equipped with factory air suspension. Set the ride height of your Tesla Model X to suit an OEM+ wheel setup or a more purposeful road stance. This vehicle-specific BAAN kit works with the original ride-height sensors and does not require an electronic lowering controller. Key benefits for the Model X Complete vehicle-specific solution: The price includes a complete vehicle-specific lowering-link set for the front and rear axles. Adjustable while installed: opposing left-hand and right-hand threads allow fine adjustment by rotating the central adjuster while the links remain connected to the vehicle. Corrosion-resistant construction: precision-machined aluminium adjusters are combined with stainless-steel link ends and ball-joint sockets for exposed underbody use. Secure mechanical retention: locking nuts secure the selected length and dual metal safety-retaining clips help keep the sockets connected to the factory sensor balls. No coding or electronic module: the links mechanically change the ride-height sensor reference without adding a controller to the vehicle wiring. Reversible installation: the original sensor links can be reinstalled to return the vehicle to its original configuration. Model X lowering range Front axle 0 to approximately 50 mm lower Rear axle 0 to approximately 50 mm lower Front and rear settings can be fine-tuned independently where applicable. The final measured ride height depends on the original vehicle calibration, suspension mode, vehicle load, tyre pressure and wheel-and-tyre configuration. Substantial lowering should be assessed for tyre clearance, suspension travel and road suitability. Replacing the fixed original links with adjustable BAAN links changes the mechanical reference supplied to the suspension controller. The vehicle then maintains a lower static position without software coding or an electronic signal-interception module. body: The ESS supercharger system for the Lamborghini Huracan V10 TS-800, the uncompromised performance. That’s the motto that’s come to define ESS as a company. It intrinsically drives them every day to produce only the best possible solutions. With this mindset, they have set off to create a V10 supercharger kit for the Lamborghini Huracan. The ESS kit is 100% bolt-on with a bracket and belt system to ensure a perfect fit with no modifications to your vehicle of any kind. The system was designed around an air-to-water intercooled big 2.9L Whipple Twin Screw Supercharger putting out 7-8 psi. The Whipple unit features newly-engineered Gen. 3 rotors which add up to 30-150 hp/tq at the same boost levels and see a decrease of 10-80 degrees Fahrenheit over the previous Gen. 2 rotors. Additionally, the twin screw design utilized by Whipple has the highest efficiency of all superchargers. This translates to more accessible power across all rpm levels, meaning instant power on tap from idle to redline. This unit can have the boost cranked to upwards of 15 psi and gives you plenty of room for upgrades down the road. The manifold plate assembly is CNC’d from thick 6061-T6 aluminum to ensure an optimal fit and seal, mitigating any chance of warping under high heat and pressure. The pulley set is engineerd for maximum performance and reliability, machining them out of the same 6061-T6 aluminum and fitting them with ceramic bearings from SKF. With a 150-180 WHP gain over stock and a 40% increase in peak torque, this kit has been created to be a monster out on the track, as well as, an enjoyable daily driver. Included with the kit, is the ESS ECU tune and all of the accompanying parts you will need to complete the install and as always, we stand behind our product with a 2-year, unlimited mile warranty.

body: The HRE R101LW Lightweight motorsport wheels for the Porsche 997 widebody in 20 inch, the forged y-spoke wheel features a concave design. title: KW Height adjustable spring kit BMW M2 f87
body: KW Height adjustable spring kit for BMW M2 F87 . The KW HAS kit is used for lowering the vehicle in combination with the serial dampers and EDC, even when electronic damper control is installed. This lowering solution from KW Suspension optimises the dynamic performance and the steering behaviour without the electronic damper control deactivated. For this solution vehicle specific adjustable spring seats with adjusted KW lowering springs and the matching elastomer as well as the dust cover system will be used. With conventional lowering springs you have to decide on the lowering from the beginning, but not with the KW height adjustable spring kits. Depending on the vehicle specific application you can change the lowering within the adjustment range with the threaded spring perch when the springs are already installed. In this case for the BMW M2 the KW height adjustable spring kit lowers the car in the range of 0-20 mm front and rear. You will not have any difficulties to adjust the lowering when changing your wheel/tire combination. title: OZ Racing Hyper GT
body: The OZ Hyper GT wheel, OZ poured all of its experience in GT3 racing into this wheel design. Quite often, choosing a wheel for one’s car is part of making an aesthetic statement. But they wanted to do something different and extra. So, they created the HyperGT HLT. A new approach to alloy rims, an authentic heir of the world of racing and, specifically, GT racing, in which OZ has set the standard for many years. The HyperGT HLT is a distillation of engineering know-how acquired over decades of design experience, filled with details and technological solutions drawn from racing culture. The resulting wheel expresses the perfect balance between light-weight, rigidity and durability, just as racing wheels have shown us they should be. Indeed, being super light-weight is not enough. When it comes to performance, a series of other parameters that allow the wheel to perform at the highest levels must be taken into consideration. The magic formula for performance is: rigidity, to make the wheel more reactive; light-weight, for better handling and strength to cope with mechanical stresses. When these three elements are perfectly balanced, you achieve the top performance that only HyperGT HLT can ensure.
